title.rendered: Cat Battles codes (October 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Cat Battles codes on October 28, 2026

Roblox is packed with all kinds of wacky games, but Cat Battles is one you shouldn’t miss. In this physics-based arena brawler, you control a cat and battle other players by punching, grabbing, kicking, and tossing them out of the ring. Your goal is simple: be the last cat standing.

Winning isn’t just about throwing punches, though. You’ll need to use your abilities strategically and earn Coins to unlock cosmetic rewards and customize your cat. That’s where Cat Battles codes come in handy! Redeem them for free Coins and get more opportunities to collect furs, gear, and emotes.

All working Cat Battles codes

  • 5kWHISKUR: 250 Coins
  • ZOOMIEZ10K: 250 Coins
  • 10MLOAFF: 250 Coins
  • YARNZ2K: 250 Coins
  • 1KCHONKY: 250 Coins
  • CATS: 150 Coins
  • NEWGAME: 250 Coins
  • RELEASE: 250 Coins 

As of now, these are the only active Cat Battles codes available. Make sure to redeem them as soon as possible, as codes can expire without warning, leaving you unable to claim their rewards.

Expired Cat Battles codes

Currently, there are no expired Cat Battles codes available. We’ll make sure to update this list as soon as possible whenever a code expires.

How to redeem Cat Battles codes in Roblox

Now that you have the codes, here’s how to redeem them and claim your rewards.

  1. Fire up Cat Battles on Roblox.
  2. Wait for the lobby to load and complete the short tutorial.
  3. Click on the gear icon.
  4. Paste a working code and hit Redeem to claim your reward.

Once you’ve redeemed the codes, the rewards should be added to your inventory automatically.

Why aren’t my Cat Battles codes working?

Are your Cat Battles codes not working? Well, double-check that you’ve entered them exactly as listed above. Keep in mind that these codes are case-sensitive, so make sure there are no extra spaces before or after them.

You can simply copy and paste the codes directly from our list. If a code still doesn’t work, it might have expired, or you may have already redeemed its rewards.

How to get more Cat Battles codes

The developers don’t follow a fixed schedule for releasing new Cat Battles codes. Most codes are released to celebrate major game updates, seasonal events, bug fixes, or community milestones.

To stay updated, you can:

  • Join the official Discord server: Visit the Cat Battles Discord server to find announcements and newly released codes.
  • Follow the Roblox game page: Check the game’s official Roblox page and the developer PONOS Corporation community for updates, announcements, and potential code releases.
  • Bookmark this page: We’ll update this guide whenever new Cat Battles codes become available, so you can easily find the latest rewards in one place.

If you’re looking for more Roblox freebies, check out our latest Hollow codes, Anime Ball Duels codes, and our complete Roblox Game Codes hub.

FAQs

How do you win in Cat Battles?

In order to win in Cat Battles, make sure you’re using your cats strategically. Take out your opponents in battles, and upgrade your team to improve its strength. Also, make sure to choose the right cats for your playstyle.

How do you get coins in Cat Battles?

You can earn coins in Cat Battles by taking part in battles, defeating enemies, and progressing through the game. The coins can be used to get upgrades and improve your cats.

How many abilities are there in Cat Battles?

After the latest Alien Invasion update, there are a total of 11 abilities you can use in Cat Battles.

title.rendered: Gemini Notebook adds built-in audio recorder to Android and iOS apps

content.rendered:
Google is making it easier to record lectures, meetings, and voice notes with a new built-in audio recorder for its Gemini Notebook apps on Android and iOS. The feature, now widely rolling out as of October 27, 2026, lets users capture audio directly in the app and save recordings alongside other research materials. So you don’t need to switch between separate recording and note-taking apps.

Gemini Notebook gets a dedicated audio recorder

The new recorder appears as a microphone icon at the bottom of the Gemini Notebook app, positioned between the camera and Create New floating action buttons.

Users can tap the microphone to start recording audio. Starting a recording from the home screen creates a new notebook, while recording from the Sources tab saves the audio to an existing notebook.

This makes it easier to organize recordings by subject, project, or research topic. Students can record lectures, professionals can capture meeting discussions, and users can save spoken ideas for later reference.

Record audio in the background for up to one hour

Gemini Notebook’s recording interface includes pause and finish controls, along with a waveform animation and a timer to show recording progress.

One particularly useful addition is support for background recording. Users can switch to another app or lock their phone’s screen without interrupting an active recording.

However, each recording session is limited to one hour. After recording finishes, the audio uploads to Gemini Notebook and becomes part of the notebook’s source materials.

Notebook creation gets a small Improvement

Google has also simplified the notebook creation process. Tapping the floating Create New button now immediately starts a new notebook instead of opening a panel for adding a source.

The update complements Gemini Notebook’s existing AI-powered research and learning tools, helping users manage information without constantly switching between apps.

How to get the audio recorder

To use the recording feature, open the Gemini Notebook app on your phone and look for the microphone icon near the bottom of the screen.

Tap it to start recording, then tap the checkmark when you’re done to finish the session. The recording is saved as a source in your notebook, where you can chat with it, cite it, and keep building your research by adding other sources.

Google first announced the feature on September 15, 2026, and it is now widely rolling out to mobile users. The initial rollout covers users who have English set as their output language. If the microphone icon is missing, try force-stopping and reopening the app, although availability may vary during the rollout.

Overall, the built-in recorder makes Gemini Notebook a more practical tool for students, researchers, and professionals who want to keep audio recordings and research materials together.

excerpt.rendered: Record lectures, meetings, and voice notes inside the Gemini Notebook app, with up to one hour per session and recording that keeps going in the background.

title.rendered: Hollow codes (October 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Hollow codes on October 28, 2026

Are you a fan of the anime Bleach? If so, you should give Hollow a try! In this Roblox action RPG, you can choose between a Hollow, Soul Reaper, or Arrancar and embark on quests, fight enemies and bosses, and unlock powerful skills and weapons as you work your way up.

However, becoming the strongest fighter isn’t easy. You’ll need the right abilities and character build to gain an edge over your opponents. That’s where Hollow codes come in handy! Redeem them for free rerolls and EXP boosts to customize your character and speed up your progression.

All working Hollow codes

  • 4500Likes: 6 Ability Rerolls
  • 3500LIKES: 6 Ability Rerolls
  • 3000LIKES: 6 Ability Rerolls
  • HOLLOWTEST3: 2 Body Type Rerolls
  • HOLLOWTEST1: 30 minutes of 2× EXP

As of now, these are the only active Hollow codes available. Make sure to redeem them as soon as possible, as codes can expire without warning, leaving you unable to claim their rewards.

Expired Hollow codes

As of now, there are no expired Hollow codes. We’ll make sure to update this list as soon as possible whenever one of the codes mentioned above expires.

How to redeem Hollow codes in Roblox

Once you’ve picked the codes you want to use, follow these steps to claim your free Coins.

  1. Fire up Hollow on Roblox.
  2. Wait for the lobby to load and complete the short tutorial.
  3. Click on the gamepad icon to open the menu.
  4. Choose the Codes section.
  5. Paste a working code and hit Redeem to claim your reward.

Once you’ve redeemed the codes, the rewards should be added to your inventory automatically.

Why aren’t my Hollow codes working?

If your Hollow codes aren’t working, double-check that you’ve entered them exactly as listed above. Keep in mind that these codes are case-sensitive, so make sure there are no extra spaces before or after them.

You can simply copy and paste the codes directly from our list. If a code still doesn’t work, it might have expired, or you may have already redeemed its rewards.

How to get more Hollow codes

The developers don’t follow a fixed schedule for releasing new Hollow codes. Most codes are released to celebrate major game updates, seasonal events, bug fixes, or community milestones.

To stay updated, you can:

  • Join the official Discord server: Visit the Hollow Discord server to find announcements and newly released codes.
  • Follow the Roblox game page: Check the game’s official Roblox page and community for updates, announcements, and potential code releases.
  • Bookmark this page: We’ll update this guide whenever new Hollow codes become available, so you can easily find the latest rewards in one place.

If you’re looking for more Roblox freebies, check out our latest Above The Rim codes, Anime Ball Duels codes, and our complete Roblox Game Codes hub.

FAQs

How do you get free rewards in Hollow?

You can earn free rewards in Hollow by progressing through the game and completing tasks. However, the easiest method to get rewards is by redeeming codes for free rerolls and XP boosts.

What are the races in Hollow?

HOLLOW features three main paths: Hollow, Soul Reaper, and Arrancar. Each offers different progression options and abilities, allowing you to develop a character that suits your preferred playstyle.

How do you level up quickly in Hollow?

The best way to level up in Hollow is by completing missions, defeating NPC enemies, and using EXP boosts whenever it is possible.

title.rendered: iPhone 18e leak reveals two major upgrades, but keeps a 60Hz display

content.rendered:
Apple’s upcoming iPhone 18e could bring two significant upgrades: a faster A20 chip and a potentially improved selfie camera. However, the same leak suggests the budget-friendly iPhone may retain its 60Hz display and single rear camera.

A recent Weibo post from leaker Digital Chat Station shared early details about Apple’s next entry-level iPhone, expected in spring 2027 alongside the rumored iPhone 18 and iPhone Air 2. Apple has not officially confirmed the device or its specifications.

iPhone 18e could feature Apple’s A20 chip

One of the biggest rumored upgrades is Apple’s A20 processor. The iPhone 18e could move from the iPhone 17e’s 3nm A19 chip to the next-generation A20, potentially bringing it in line with the upcoming standard iPhone 18.

The A20 is expected to use a 2-nanometer manufacturing process. So far, the A20 family has only appeared as the A20 Pro in the iPhone 18 Pro models, so it would be a significant performance leap for Apple’s budget iPhone if accurate.

Front camera upgrade could improve selfies

The leak also points to a possible front-camera upgrade. The iPhone 18e could feature a 24-megapixel selfie camera, compared with the 12-megapixel camera on the iPhone 17e.

A higher-resolution camera could capture more detail in selfies and offer greater flexibility when cropping photos. However, it’s unclear whether the leaker is referring to a new sensor or mistakenly to the 18MP Center Stage camera used in the iPhone 17 lineup. Either way, it would be an upgrade over the iPhone 17e.

60Hz display and single rear camera may remain

Despite these potential improvements, the iPhone 18e could retain a 6.12-inch OLED display with LTPS technology and a 60Hz refresh rate.

This means users may not get the smoother scrolling and animations available on iPhones with 120Hz ProMotion displays. The phone is also expected to keep a single 48-megapixel rear camera and other specs similar to its predecessor. Separately, analyst Ming-Chi Kuo has reported that the iPhone 18e could get 9GB of RAM, up from 8GB on the iPhone 17e.

iPhone 18e release date: What to expect

Apple could launch the iPhone 18e in spring 2027 as part of its reportedly revised iPhone release schedule. There is no official information on pricing or the release date yet.

With memory and storage prices rising, Apple may need to balance hardware improvements against production costs. Since the iPhone 18e is intended to remain a budget-friendly option, Apple could limit upgrades compared with a typical yearly refresh to keep the price competitive.

For now, all specifications and release details remain unconfirmed until Apple makes an official announcement.

title.rendered: The Final Spritemare in Fortnite: Full schedule, boosted Sprites, and login rewards

content.rendered:
Fortnite Override and Fortnitemares 2026 have entered their final stretch. As a result, the devs have decided to give players one final push to complete their sprite collection through a series of boosted days, known together as The Final Spritemare, during which the spawn rates of certain sprites will go up.

The event runs from October 27 to October 31, 2026, with daily changes starting at 9 AM ET (6:30 PM IST). Across the five days, players can earn double Sprite XP and Sprite Dust, claim a Lucky Locator through a daily login quest, and find additional loot in chests.

With 162 Fortnite sprite entries released throughout the season, including variants, this is a valuable opportunity for completionists to fill the remaining gaps in their collections before the next Fortnite season begins.

The Final Spritemare full schedule

Here’s the complete schedule for The Final Spritemare, including each day’s boosted Sprite variants, loot-pool additions, and special rewards.

Note: The daily boosts begin at 9 AM ET / 1 PM UTC and run until the following day’s changeover.

In addition to these benefits, on the final two days of the season, you will also get a few freebies and a couple other gameplay boosts. First off, those logging in on October 30 can claim the Calaverita Sprays and an emoticon for free.

Secondly, those playing the game on October 31 are certain to find the Hunter Scavenger, Prop Hunt, and Spooky Sprinter overrides in Fortnite’s Override Consoles during their matches. Moreover, the total number of Pumpkin Chests will also be aped up on this day, further helping players grow their collection.

The Final Spritemare: Daily login rewards and boosts

Besides the rotating daily changes, The Final Spritemare includes several bonuses that remain active throughout the event. These rewards and boosts make it easier to find, collect, and master Sprites before the season ends.

Here’s what you can expect:

  1. Double Sprite XP: Earn twice the usual Sprite XP to help level up your collected Sprites.
  2. Double Sprite Dust: Collect twice the usual Sprite Dust during the event.
  3. Daily Lucky Locator: Complete the daily login quest to earn a Lucky Locator. You can claim one on each of the five event days.
  4. Extra chest loot: 1-Up Tokens and Portable Extractors may appear in chests.

These bonuses are especially useful if you’re still working toward completing your Sprite collection. The double XP and Sprite Dust boosts also help you progress toward Sprite Mastery, while Lucky Locators can help you track down Sprites you haven’t discovered yet.

If you’re missing specific variants, make the most of the daily boosts instead of relying entirely on random encounters. For example, focus on Gold and Cheat Master Sprites on October 27, Loot Hacker on October 28, Bounty Hunter on October 29, and Trick or Treat on October 30.

The event’s double Sprite XP and Sprite Dust bonuses also reduce the grind involved in progressing through Sprite Mastery. This can be particularly helpful for special variants, including Quack Sprites, which have their own collection and mastery requirements.

Countdown to Fortnite Treasure Hunters

As Fortnite Override draws to a close, the next seasonal experience is approaching. Epic Games has teased Fortnite Treasure Hunters, a new One Piece-themed mini-season scheduled to begin on November 1, 2026.

One of the biggest teasers so far is a giant treasure chest that players can find in Fortnite Battle Royale. The chest has also attracted attention for the music that plays nearby. You can read more about it in our guide to the One Piece chest location in Fortnite.

Override has focused heavily on gaming franchises, weapons, Match Overrides, and collectible Sprites. Treasure Hunters is set to shift the spotlight toward the popular One Piece anime and its pirate-adventure theme.

With the current season nearing its end, The Final Spritemare gives players one last chance to work on their Sprite collections while enjoying the event’s boosted rewards. If you’ve been putting off Sprite Mastery, use the remaining days wisely before Fortnite moves on to its next chapter.

title.rendered: ChatGPT can now access iCloud Mail and Calendar to manage emails and events

content.rendered:
OpenAI has added iCloud Mail and Calendar integrations to ChatGPT, giving Apple users a new way to manage their emails and appointments through the AI chatbot. Announced on October 27, the integrations let users search their iCloud inboxes, catch up on messages, check upcoming events, and update calendar entries in ChatGPT.

The new integrations are available across all ChatGPT plans, including the free tier, on the web, desktop, and iOS. This lets the chatbot work with information stored in Apple’s services rather than relying entirely on what users manually provide in conversations.

OpenAI announces iCloud Mail and Calendar integrations

OpenAI announced the rollout on its official ChatGPT account on X, describing the integrations as a long-requested addition.

Much requested, and now yours to connect: iCloud Mail and Calendar plugins are available in ChatGPT. Ask ChatGPT to find that email, catch up on your inbox, check what’s next, or update a calendar event. Phew. Available on all ChatGPT plans on web, desktop, and iOS. https://t.co/g68OWoFVg8

— ChatGPT (@ChatGPT) October 27, 2026

The company confirmed availability across all ChatGPT plans on web, desktop, and iOS.

The update lets you connect your Apple email and calendar accounts to ChatGPT, which previously supported only Google and Microsoft services like Gmail and Google Calendar. OpenAI has also rolled out the Apple Messages plugin, but it’s available only in Work and Codex mode on the Mac app.

ChatGPT can search iCloud emails and manage messages

The iCloud Mail integration allows ChatGPT to search and read emails, manage messages and drafts, send emails, and look up iCloud contacts. This gives users a conversational way to retrieve information buried in their inboxes, summarize mail threads, or handle routine email tasks.

However, the integration is built specifically for iCloud Mail. It supports Apple email addresses ending in @icloud.com, @me.com, and @mac.com. Other email accounts configured in Apple’s Mail app, including Gmail and Outlook, aren’t automatically included.

iCloud Calendar integration brings scheduling to ChatGPT

The iCloud Calendar integration lets ChatGPT read scheduled events, create calendar entries, and update existing events through natural-language requests. For example, you can ask ChatGPT to check your upcoming appointments or find an available time for a meeting.

The integration also works with events displayed in the iPhone’s Calendar app, or any third-party calendar app, when they are stored in iCloud Calendar. This is useful for Apple users who manage their appointments across different apps but keep their calendar data synchronized through iCloud.

The integrations extend ChatGPT’s connected-app capabilities

The iCloud announcement also has implications for OpenAI’s broader AI assistant strategy. ChatGPT plugins allow the chatbot to use information from external services when responding to requests, making it more useful for everyday productivity tasks.

The integrations can also be used by OpenAI’s proactive AI agent, Dots, for the first time. However, that doesn’t mean every feature or agent, like Work or Codex, can use them in exactly the same way.

To connect either service, users must create an Apple app-specific password. This is separate from their regular Apple Account password. Then simply open ChatGPT, go to Settings > Plugins, and select iCloud Mail or iCloud Calendar. Otherwise, ask a ChatGPT Dot to set up the plugins. Each plugin is connected separately: Mail uses your iCloud email address, while Calendar uses your primary Apple Account email.

The rollout is notable because it includes free ChatGPT users, not just paid subscribers. That gives more Apple users access to the new capabilities without requiring an upgrade.

title.rendered: Apple unveils 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 chip and up to 24-hour battery

content.rendered:
Apple has officially introduced its new 14-inch MacBook Pro powered by the M6 chip, alongside a new M6-powered iMac. The new laptop brings faster graphics, improved AI performance, enhanced battery life, and advanced wireless capabilities.

The M6 model retains the Liquid Retina XDR display and familiar MacBook Pro design. Pre-orders open October 28, with prices starting at $1,999.

M6 chip brings faster performance and AI capabilities

At the heart of the new 14-inch MacBook Pro is Apple’s M6 chip, featuring a 12-core CPU and a 12-core GPU, two more cores each than the M5. As per Apple, the new processor is built to handle everyday tasks and demanding professional applications, such as software development, 3D rendering, and AI-powered workflows.

Compared with the M5, the M6 offers up to 30% faster graphics performance and up to 25% faster AI workloads. It also features Neural Accelerators in every GPU core and a third-generation ray-tracing engine. According to Apple, the M6 speeds up project build performance in Xcode and LLM prompt processing by up to 1.3x compared with the 14-inch MacBook Pro with M5.

Apple also equipped the chip with a Dual 16-core Neural Engine, up to 1.9x faster than the M5, to support AI features across macOS. This includes running large language models locally, allowing supported AI workloads to run directly on the Mac rather than relying entirely on cloud processing.

Memory and storage get an upgrade

The 14-inch MacBook Pro comes with 16GB of unified memory as standard and is customizable to 32GB. Memory bandwidth goes up to 170GB/s, which makes it capable of running demanding applications, large projects, and multiple workloads more efficiently.

The new model starts with a 1TB SSD, double the 512GB the 14-inch M5 model offered at launch.

Familiar design with a Liquid Retina XDR display

Apple retained the 14-inch Liquid Retina XDR display, which offers high contrast, detailed visuals, and HDR support. The display reaches up to 1,600 nits of peak HDR brightness and provides a 1,000,000:1 contrast ratio.

Users can also configure the MacBook Pro with an optional nano-texture display finish designed to reduce reflections in bright environments. It could be helpful for professionals who have to work under studio lights or near a window.

The laptop retains a premium aluminum body in Space Black and Silver. While the M6 brings significant internal improvements, Apple has kept the familiar design.

Connectivity, camera, and audio features

The new 14-inch MacBook Pro adds Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, supporting newer wireless standards when paired with compatible networks and accessories.

Physical ports include:

  • Three Thunderbolt 4 ports
  • An HDMI port
  • An SDXC card slot
  • MagSafe 3 charging
  • A headphone jack

The laptop also supports up to two external displays, making it suitable for multi-monitor workstations.

For video calls, Apple retains a 12MP Center Stage camera with Desk View support. The laptop also includes a six-speaker sound system with Spatial Audio and a studio-quality three-microphone array.

These features make the MacBook Pro suitable not only for creative production and software development but also for remote meetings, presentations, and content creation.

Battery life reaches up to 24 hours

According to Apple, the new MacBook Pro can last up to 24 hours on a single charge. This is the longest battery life Apple has advertised for a Mac, though actual runtime depends on workload, settings, and configuration.

The laptop also supports fast charging. With a compatible 96W USB-C power adapter, Apple says users can charge the battery to approximately 50% in around 30 minutes.

For people who work away from a desk, the combination of improved performance per watt and long battery life could be one of the most practical benefits of the M6 upgrade.

macOS 27 and Apple Intelligence

The new MacBook Pro runs macOS 27 Golden Gate, which brings Apple’s latest software features and AI capabilities to the laptop.

Apple Intelligence and Siri AI are designed to help users work with information across supported apps, assist with writing, and perform certain tasks more efficiently. Siri AI is currently available in beta in macOS 27.2 in supported languages. The M6’s Neural Engine and GPU-based Neural Accelerators provide additional hardware support for compatible AI workloads.

The ability to run supported large language models locally may also appeal to developers and users who want to experiment with AI tools while keeping certain processing tasks on their own devices.

MacBook Pro M6 price and availability

The new 14-inch MacBook Pro with M6 starts at $1,999 in the United States, with education pricing starting at $1,899 for eligible customers. The base configuration includes 16GB of unified memory and a 1TB SSD, while higher configurations offer up to 32GB of memory and 4TB of storage.

Pre-orders begin Wednesday, October 28, and the laptop will be available in stores and begin arriving to customers on Friday, November 6.

In India, the starting price is ₹2,39,900, with an education price of ₹2,27,900 for eligible students. Indian pre-orders also begin October 28, with availability starting November 6.

In short, the new 14-inch M6-powered MacBook Pro is a significant upgrade for current M5 MacBook Pro owners and those upgrading from older Apple Silicon Macs, especially M1. It’s ideal for college students, business users, creators, and more.

title.rendered: Apple launches new iMac with M6 chip, N1 wireless upgrades, and more

content.rendered:
Apple has refreshed its colorful all-in-one desktop with a major performance upgrade. On October 27, 2026, Apple announced a new iMac powered by its M6 chip, delivering faster performance, improved graphics, and more powerful AI capabilities.

The updated model continues Apple’s focus on combining powerful hardware with a slim design and a simple all-in-one desktop setup. It starts at $1,499, with pre-orders opening on October 28 at 10:10 a.m. PT (1:10 p.m. ET) and availability from November 6.

New iMac gets Apple’s powerful M6 chip

The biggest upgrade is Apple’s M6 chip, which improves computing and graphics performance while supporting more demanding AI workloads. Built on a 2-nm process, it features up to a 12-core CPU, a 12-core GPU, and a Dual 16-core Neural Engine, with support for up to 32GB of unified memory and up to 170GB/s of memory bandwidth.

Compared with the M4-powered iMac, which offers up to a 10-core CPU and 10-core GPU, the M6 model delivers a significant performance boost. Apple claims up to 1.5x faster performance in apps like Microsoft Excel, twice as fast graphics, and 5x faster on-device AI performance.

These improvements could benefit demanding apps, video editing, and AI-powered tools. For people who have an M4 iMac, this update will be most noticeable when handling graphics- and AI-heavy tasks. Users coming from older Macs will have a better experience altogether.

Familiar all-in-one design with a 4.5K Retina display

Apple has retained the iMac’s distinctive slim design rather than introducing a dramatic redesign. It features a 24-inch 4.5K Retina display, designed to deliver sharp text, detailed images, and vibrant colors.

Apple is offering the iMac in seven colors: blue, green, pink, yellow, purple, orange, and silver.

The all-in-one format remains one of the iMac’s biggest advantages. Users can set up their workspace without needing a separate desktop tower and monitor, making it a convenient choice for home offices, students, and people who prefer a clean desk setup.

Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, and faster SSD performance

Beyond the processor, Apple has improved connectivity and storage in the new iMac.

The M6 model includes an N1 wireless chip that supports Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6. The 12-core models also offer optional 2.5 Gigabit Ethernet with “up to 2.5x faster wired connectivity than the previous generation” for users who prefer a wired network connection.

Apple says the new iMac also delivers up to twice as fast SSD read and write performance compared with the M4 model. Faster storage can help with file transfers, loading applications, and workflows involving large files.

These upgrades may be particularly useful for creative professionals who regularly work with large photo libraries, video projects, and other storage-intensive content.

iMac M6 price and pre-orders

The new M6-powered iMac starts at $1,499 in the US for the base configuration with a 10-core CPU, 10-core GPU, 16GB of unified memory, 256GB of storage, and two Thunderbolt/USB 4 ports. Apple also offers a higher-end configuration with a 12-core CPU, 12-core GPU, and four Thunderbolt 4 ports, starting at $1,699.

On the 12-core model, users can choose up to 32GB of unified memory and up to 2TB of storage.

With education pricing, the two models start at $1,449 and $1,599. In India, the iMac with M6 starts at ₹1,74,900 for the 10-core model and ₹1,99,900 for the 12-core model.

Pre-orders for the new iMac begin on October 28, 2026, and it will be available from November 6, 2026, at Apple Store locations and authorized resellers.

acceptedAnswer.text: Minecraft Java is suited for players who like to install mods and join custom servers. However, Minecraft Bedrock is suited for players with lower-end systems and who want to play with friends across different devices.

acceptedAnswer.text: Unfortunately, Minecraft Java and Bedrock players can't play together as they use different multiplayer systems.

title.rendered: All GTA 6 exclusive features PS5 players can enjoy

content.rendered:
It’s hard to believe, but Grand Theft Auto 6 is now just a few weeks away from launch. After years of delays, rumors, and endless speculation, Rockstar Games is preparing to take us back to Vice City on November 19, 2026. Pre-orders are already live for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S.

Although GTA 6 is launching on both consoles, PlayStation has highlighted several features designed to make the experience more immersive on PS5. These include the DualSense controller’s haptic feedback and adaptive triggers, which respond to the action as Jason and Lucia explore Leonida.

So, what advantages can you expect if you’re playing GTA 6 on a PS5 or PS5 Pro? And are any of these features genuinely exclusive to Sony’s console? Here’s everything we know so far.

GTA 6 PS5 features at a glance

Are these GTA 6 features actually PS5 exclusive?

Rockstar’s marketing might make you think PS5 players will get access to features that Xbox Series X/S users won’t be able to experience. However, that’s not entirely true. The thing to note here is that Sony has a marketing deal with Rockstar, which explains why PlayStation branding is all over GTA 6 trailers, and why the game is being promoted as playing best on PS5. It’s a way for Sony to associate its brand with one of the biggest game releases in history.

However, the PS5 and Xbox Series X/S versions of GTA 6 are all set to bring the same gameplay experience. The real difference comes in how the game uses the PS5’s DualSense controller. Features such as haptic feedback and adaptive triggers simply aren’t present on Xbox controllers. The game plans to use these features to make Jason and Lucia’s journey feel more immersive. The PS5 Pro should also deliver a better experience compared to the base consoles, as it packs more powerful hardware.

Every GTA 6 PS5 feature explained

We’ve already covered all the GTA 6 PS5 features you need to know about in the table above. Now, let’s take a closer look at each feature and explain how it could enhance your overall gameplay experience on Sony’s console.

1. Tempest 3D audio

Rockstar Games has gone out of its way with GTA 6’s audio design, from its soundtrack featuring the likes of Travis Scott, Keith Richards, and PinkPantheress to environmental sounds that bring Leonida to life. On PS5, players will be able to take advantage of Sony’s Tempest 3D AudioTech for a more immersive sound experience. It can make in-game audio feel more realistic and spatial, making the world feel even more alive.

2. SSD loading

If there’s one thing GTA 5 players have dealt with for years, it’s loading screens. Thankfully, the PS5’s high-speed SSD should make this less of an issue in GTA 6. The console’s storage technology allows game data to load much faster, which reduces the time players spend waiting to get back into the action. PlayStation has described it as “near-instant load times”, which should make moving around Leonida and completing missions feel like a breeze.

3. Adaptive triggers

The DualSense controller’s adaptive triggers are designed to make in-game actions feel different depending on what’s happening on screen. In GTA 6, this could make activities like driving and shooting feel more realistic. You will feel changes in trigger resistance when firing weapons, or different levels of tension during intense encounters. These small details can make the game feel even more engaging.

4. Haptic feedback

PS5’s haptic feedback will be a game-changer in GTA 6. You will feel the impact of explosions, the fumble of a vehicle, and even the sensation of parachuting through the air. Even smaller interactions will produce vibrations and add another layer of immersion as you explore Leonida.

5. Integrated speaker

Another feature that GTA 6 plans to use is the DualSense’s integrated speaker. Combined with haptics, it could make certain moments feel more immediate by letting you hear and feel part of the action through the controller itself. We’ll have to wait for more gameplay details to learn exactly how this plays out.

Is GTA 6 PS5 Pro Enhanced? What we know

Over on the PlayStation Store, GTA 6 has been listed as PS5 Pro Enhanced. This means that the game can make use of the hardware capabilities of Sony’s most powerful console. Unfortunately, the listing doesn’t exactly tell us what these improvements will look like.

We don’t know whether PS5 Pro owners will get higher frame rates or improvements to certain aspects of the game. One of the biggest unanswered questions is whether GTA 6 will offer a dedicated 60 FPS mode on the console. Until Rockstar shares more information about the game’s performance, it’s too early to say how much of an advantage the PS5 Pro will have over the standard console.

Will GTA 6 run at 60 FPS on PS5?

While the PS5 Pro should bring some improvements over the standard PS5, it’s still unclear whether either console will be able to run GTA 6 at 60 FPS. Rockstar Games hasn’t confirmed a 60 FPS mode for the PS5, PS5 Pro, or even Xbox Series X/S.

According to YouTuber Davy Jones, who had the opportunity to visit Rockstar North and chat with the game’s co-director Rob Nelson, GTA 6 is targeting 30 FPS at launch. However, Nelson said he would need to check with his technical team on whether a 60 FPS mode could be made available at launch or later.

What’s interesting to note is that speculation about GTA 6 running at 60 FPS on the PS5 Pro picked up again in August 2026. This was when well-known insider HipHopGamer made claims about the game’s performance on the upgraded console. However, Rockstar hasn’t officially backed up these claims, so it’s better to wait for more details before drawing any conclusions.

— SHADE45 | HOT97 | CHASE | GGL | AMD | THE GOAT (@HipHopGamer) August 28, 2026

How to set up your PS5 for GTA 6 before Nov 19

If you’re planning to jump into GTA 6 the moment it launches, here’s a list of things we recommend doing beforehand to make sure your PS5 is ready for the game:

1. Free up storage space

It’s rumored that GTA 6 could take over 200 GB of storage, based on the reported size of a development build. While Rockstar hasn’t confirmed the exact file size yet, it’s a good idea to clear some space on your PS5 before pre-loads begin on November 12. Even the boxed edition contains a download code rather than a disc, so everyone will need the space. Here’s how to do that:

  1. Open Settings on your PS5.
  2. Select Storage.
  3. Choose Console Storage to see how much space is available.
  4. Delete games or applications you no longer use if you need more room.
  5. Leave some extra space for game updates.

2. Update your PS5 system software

Before GTA 6 launches, make sure your PS5 is running the latest system software. Keeping your console updated can prevent compatibility issues and ensure you have the latest system improvements. Follow these steps to check for updates:

  1. Open Settings on your PS5
  2. Choose System, then go to System Software.
  3. Select System Software Update and Settings.
  4. Hit Update System Software and install any available updates.

GTA 6 limited-edition DualSense controllers

Rockstar Games and Sony have something special in store for GTA fans, with limited-edition DualSense controllers inspired by GTA 6. These are available in two variants, Black and White, and feature designs inspired by Vice City’s neon-lit nightlife, palm trees, and iconic sunsets alongside the official GTA 6 branding. The Black edition is exclusive to PlayStation Direct, while the White edition is also sold through other retailers.

Of course, they still come with all the usual DualSense features, including the likes of haptic feedback, adaptive triggers, and a touchpad. Priced at $84.99, these controllers launch on November 19 and are produced in limited quantities, so be quick to get one before they’re gone.

GTA 6 PS5 price and editions

GTA 6 comes in two editions: Standard and Ultimate, each offering a different set of in-game bonuses. If you’re wondering which version to buy, we’ve put together a breakdown of all GTA 6 versions to help you make the right call. However, if you want a quick overview, here’s what you can expect from each version:

Wrapping up

GTA 6 is shaping up to be one of the biggest releases of the year, and PS5 players have a confirmed advantage in how the game uses the DualSense controller. Haptic feedback and adaptive triggers are designed to make the action feel more immersive, while the PS5 Pro listing confirms that the game is enhanced for Sony’s more powerful console.

However, not every feature associated with PS5 is exclusive to it. Both PS5 and Xbox Series X/S use SSD storage, and Rockstar hasn’t confirmed that PlayStation players will receive exclusive story content. We also don’t yet know whether either PS5 model will offer a 60 FPS mode at launch.

With the November 19 release date approaching, more technical details may emerge. Until then, keep your console updated, make room for the installation, and check official announcements for confirmed performance specifications.

FAQs

Will GTA 6 support all DualSense features?

PlayStation has confirmed support for DualSense haptic feedback, adaptive triggers, and the integrated speaker. However, exactly how each feature is used in specific missions and moments hasn’t been detailed yet.

Is GTA 6 coming to PS4?

No. GTA 6 is scheduled to launch on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S. Rockstar has not announced a PS4 version.

Will GTA 6 look better on PS5 than Xbox?

Both consoles are expected to offer the same core game, but their technical implementations may differ. Rockstar hasn’t published a complete side-by-side comparison of graphics quality or performance, so it’s too early to declare one version definitively better.

Is GTA 6 a PS5 exclusive?

No. GTA 6 is scheduled to release on both PS5 and Xbox Series X/S on November 19, 2026. A PC release date has not been officially announced.

When can I preload GTA 6 on PS5?

title.rendered: Beetlejuice in Fortnite: Skin, bundle, prices, and more

content.rendered:
Ever since Beetlejuice was teased in the official key art for Fortnitemares 2026, fans of the classic horror comedy have been waiting for the crossover to arrive in Fortnite. Now, the iconic character and a collection of themed cosmetics are available in the Item Shop, where they went live on October 23, 2026, at 5 PM PT / 8 PM ET.

The Beetlejuice outfit costs 1,500 V-Bucks, while the full Beetlejuice Bundle costs 2,400 V-Bucks. The outfit also comes with Beetlejuice’s Marquee back bling. The bundle includes eight cosmetics, with a listed original combined value of 5,300 V-Bucks, so it saves you 2,900 V-Bucks. However, the two Beetlejuice-themed Jam Tracks are sold separately.

The cosmetics are scheduled to leave the Item Shop on November 2, 2026. If you want to add the ghost with the most to your locker, here’s how to get the skin and a breakdown of every item and its price.

How to get the Beetlejuice skin in Fortnite

  1. In Fortnite, navigate to the Item Shop tab.
  2. After that, scroll down until the Beetlejuice section appears and select the desired skin.
  3. Finally, press and hold the Purchase button to confirm your decision.

Every Beetlejuice collab item in Fortnite

The Beetlejuice collection includes an outfit, a back bling, two emotes, kicks, a wrap, a pickaxe, and a guitar that doubles as a back bling and pickaxe. Two additional Jam Tracks are available separately.

1. Beetlejuice outfit

  • Price: 1,500 V-Bucks
  • Also comes with: Beetlejuice’s Marquee back bling
  • Also included in: Beetlejuice Bundle

2. Beetlejuice’s Marquee back bling

  • Price: 300 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Beetlejuice Bundle

3. Day-o emote

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Beetlejuice Bundle

4. Sandworm Surfer emote

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Beetlejuice Bundle

5. Marquee Masher pickaxe

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Beetlejuice Bundle

6. Sandworm Sneakers kicks

  • Price: 1,000 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Beetlejuice Bundle

7. Beetlejuice Spirals wrap

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Beetlejuice Bundle

8. Six-stringed Sandworm pickaxe and back bling

  • Price: 800 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Beetlejuice Bundle

9. Banana Boat (Day-O) jam track

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks

10. Jump In The Line jam track

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks

Besides the Jam Tracks, all the other items shown above make up the Beetlejuice Bundle. Although these Harry Belafonte songs were used in the Beetlejuice movie, they have only been listed as individual purchases.

Horror film crossovers in Fortnitemares 2026

The ongoing Halloween-themed Fortnitemares event is all about spooky in-game events and new cosmetics based on scary media, so horror film crossovers are right up its alley. This year, we have seen everything from horror classics such as A Nightmare on Elm Street to modern hits such as Obsession make their way into the online multiplayer title, with various themed cosmetics and gameplay updates.

As Fortnitemares 2026 comes to a close, a chunk of these Fortnite collabs also enter their final days of availability. Whether it be the Freddy’s Nightmare Mythic melee weapon or the Scream-inspired Last Call Mythic item, these parts of the game are set to bow out in a matter of days, as the One Piece-themed Treasure Hunters mini-season arrives on November 1.

However, since the cosmetics are something that you can carry forward into the next year and beyond, those looking to grab a memento of 2026’s Halloween-oriented content in Fortnite shouldn’t hesitate to go for their preferred skins, back bling, and the like while they still have some time.

Don’t miss these related reads:

  • Aetheria map in Fortnite: What it is, how to play it, beginner tips
  • How to get the Jack-O’-Cat sidekick in Fortnite before it leaves
  • Final Spritemare in Fortnite: Full schedule, boosted Sprites, and login rewards

title.rendered: iOS 27.2 is here with smarter Siri AI, Messages tools, and Pencil support

content.rendered:
Apple has released iOS 27.2, bringing a collection of new features and refinements to compatible iPhones. Released on October 26, 2026, the update expands Siri AI language support, adds contextual suggestions to Messages, refreshes Apple Music, and improves several built-in apps. It also enables Apple Pencil (USB-C) support on Apple’s foldable iPhone Duo.

Unlike a minor maintenance update, iOS 27.2 introduces changes across Photos, Podcasts, Apple TV, FaceTime, and other parts of the operating system. Apple has also expanded Siri AI language support and included more than 160 security fixes, making this an important update for eligible iPhone users.

Here’s a closer look at what’s new in iOS 27.2, which features require compatible hardware, and what you should know before updating your iPhone.

iOS 27.2 brings major improvements to Siri AI

One of the biggest changes in iOS 27.2 is the expansion of Siri AI. Apple’s updated assistant can now recall previous conversations. For example, you can ask Siri about a restaurant it recommended in a previous conversation instead of starting from scratch.

Siri AI can also draw information from more sources, including photos attached to Messages, Calendar event attendees, and voicemails. Apple has improved how Siri uses Safari browsing history and Reading List information to provide relevant answers.

The update also introduces an Excluded Apps setting. This option lets users select which apps will be available to Siri, Search, and system suggestions. Thus, you can control how Apple’s intelligent features interact with personal information.

Another useful addition is granular text selection in Siri responses. Instead of copying an entire answer, users can select and copy only the specific text they need.

Siri AI adds support for five more languages

With iOS 27.2, Siri AI expands beyond English to support five additional languages:

  • French
  • Japanese
  • Korean
  • Portuguese
  • Spanish

However, Siri AI remains unavailable in the European Union and mainland China. The feature also requires compatible hardware, including the iPhone 15 Pro and iPhone 15 Pro Max, along with the iPhone 16 series and newer supported models.

Messages gets contextual suggestions

The Messages app adds a feature called Suggestions, which helps users act on the context of their conversations.

For example, if someone sends a dinner invitation, Messages may suggest adding the event to Calendar. Other supported suggestions can help users create reminders, add information to Notes, open locations in Maps, or track flights and packages.

You can also choose which categories of suggestions you want to see, providing more control over the feature.

Apple Music gets a visual refresh

Apple Music gets a visual refresh in iOS 27.2. As part of Apple’s latest Apple Music rebranding, the update brings a redesigned black-and-white app icon that replaces its familiar red appearance.

The changes extend inside the app, where blue replaces red as the accent color for selected navigation elements. Also, Music widgets have been updated with black backgrounds to match the updated visual identity.

Photos improves Shared Albums and image transparency

The Photos app receives several practical improvements in iOS 27.2.

  • Shared Albums allows editing captions and comments so that participants can correct information or update details after posting.
  • Apple also added ways to avoid duplicate photos in those albums and to remind users before Shared Albums expire, giving participants a chance to save important images and videos.

Another notable addition is support for Google’s SynthID watermarking technology in Photos and Image Playground. This helps identify images generated in Image Playground and certain edits in Photos, including Extend and Reframe, and larger changes made with the Clean Up tool. Users can check supported images through Google’s SynthID Detector.

Podcasts and Games get smaller but useful updates

Apple has reorganized the Podcasts app’s Home tab to make it easier to find new content and resume unfinished episodes. Instead of grouping everything under Up Next, the interface now separates content into two sections: New Episodes and Continue Playing.

The Games app also receives improvements to its Friends tab. You can see more context for friend suggestions, and view recently played games on friends’ player pages to discover what other players are enjoying.

Apple TV adds profiles on iPhone and iPad

The Apple TV app now supports creating individual profiles directly in the iPhone and iPad app’s account settings. This will help families to keep their recommendations and viewing preferences separate from one another.

You can create a profile by providing a name, selecting a profile rating, and specifying whether it is intended for a child. The default setting for the child profile is PG content rating, with additional options available to customize age ratings for movies and television shows.

FaceTime adds accessibility improvements

iOS 27.2 introduces support for adding a third-party sign language interpreter or live captioner to a FaceTime call. This gives users additional ways to make conversations accessible, depending on their communication needs.

Apple has also expanded Dual Capture to group FaceTime calls on supported iPhone models. The feature lets the front and rear cameras capture video simultaneously, so users can share both their face and their surroundings during a conversation.

Dual Capture support is available on selected newer devices, including the iPhone 17 series, iPhone Air, iPhone 18 Pro models, and iPhone Duo, running the latest iOS 27 version.

Shortcuts app gets new Automation features

Apple has introduced several improvements to the Shortcuts app in iOS 27.2.

  • New iPhone Duo automation: Create automations that run when you open or close your foldable iPhone.
  • Workout automation: The “When I Start a Workout” trigger now supports the Fitness app to automate workout-related tasks.
  • Improved app automation: The “When Weather Is Opened or Closed” trigger can now provide the name of the app that was closed.
  • Easier shortcut editing: You can edit shortcut names and icons directly from the Shortcuts library on iPhone and iPad.

iPhone Duo gets Apple Pencil support

One of the more notable device-specific additions is support for Apple Pencil (USB-C) on the iPhone Duo. The feature lets you draw, annotate, and interact with supported content using a compatible Apple Pencil.

Apple had previously indicated that Pencil support would arrive later, and iOS 27.2 delivers that capability through a software update.

The update also introduces Edge Light on the iPhone Duo, which illuminates the user’s face during video calls.

More changes across iOS 27.2

Beyond the headline features, the update includes several additional improvements:

  • Apple TV Multiview: Watch up to four live sports streams simultaneously in the Apple TV app for supported sports events included in the subscription, such as Major League Soccer, Formula 1 (F1) in the U.S., and Friday Night Baseball doubleheaders during the Major League Baseball season.
  • Phone app: Call Context can remind users of a contact’s anniversary during a call when the date is saved in Contacts.
  • Home app: Compatible smart locks now offer options such as automatically locking after a door closes and alerts when a door stays open too long.
  • HomePod: A new Lock Controls setting helps prevent accidental audio playback from unwanted touches while preserving controls for functions such as timers and alarms.
  • Clock: Alarm lists now use smaller a.m. and p.m. labels.
  • App Tracking Transparency: Users in the European Union receive changes to tracking permission prompts, including an alternative expanded prompt in certain countries.

Apple also tested a redesigned Health app during the iOS 27.2 beta period. However, that redesign did not make it into the public release and is expected to arrive in a later update.

iOS 27.2 includes more than 160 security fixes

Alongside its new features, iOS 27.2 addresses more than 160 security vulnerabilities. Apple has indicated that the vulnerabilities fixed in this release were not actively exploited, but installing security updates remains an important way to protect an iPhone.

Overall, iOS 27.2 is a substantial update that makes Apple’s software more useful across everyday tasks. If you have a compatible iPhone, I recommend installing the update to take advantage of the new features, expanded AI capabilities, and important security fixes.

acceptedAnswer.text: Minecraft Java is suited for players who like to install mods and join custom servers. However, Minecraft Bedrock is suited for players with lower-end systems and who want to play with friends across different devices.

title.rendered: Best Minecraft servers to play in 2026: IPs, modes and editions

content.rendered:
There’s no denying that Minecraft is fun on its own, but playing with other people takes the experience to a whole new level. Whether you want to team up with friends, compete against other players, or explore a completely different kind of adventure, Minecraft servers offer something for everyone.

Over the years, thousands of servers have introduced unique game modes, including PvP, SkyBlock, Factions, MMORPGs, and minigames. With so many options available, choosing the right server can be tricky. To help you decide, we’ve rounded up some of the best Minecraft servers to try in 2026, from Hypixel and The Hive to the newly relaunched Mineplex, along with their server addresses, supported editions, and standout features.

Best Minecraft servers at a glance

Note: Server availability, supported Minecraft versions, and connection details can change. Check each server’s official website if you encounter connection issues.

Best Minecraft servers in 2026

1. Hypixel

Server IP Address: mc.hypixel.net

It’s safe to say that Hypixel remains one of the most popular Minecraft servers in 2026, thanks to its mix of competitive multiplayer and original minigames. It features various modes like Bed Wars, SkyBlock, SkyWars, Murder Mystery, and plenty of other games that can keep you entertained for hundreds of hours. Whether you enjoy PvP battles or prefer more relaxed gameplay, Hypixel has something for everyone.

2. The Hive

Server IP Address: geo.hivebedrock.cloud

If you’re playing Minecraft Bedrock Edition, The Hive is definitely a server worth checking out. It is packed with minigames like BedWars, Hide and Seek, Murder Mystery, DeathRun, and plenty of other modes to keep you hooked. One of the best things about The Hive is the fact that it’s accessible across multiple platforms, including mobile devices and consoles.

3. MCC Island

Server IP Address: play.mccisland.net

Next up, we have MCC Island, which takes inspiration from the popular Minecraft Championship tournament. It’s particularly famous for its fast-paced games, including Hole in the Wall, Sky Battle, and Battle Box, where you can compete against other players or team up with your friends. What makes MCC Island stand out compared to other Minecraft servers is its focus on skill-based gameplay and progression, which gives you tons of reasons to keep playing.

4. CubeCraft Games

Server IP Address: play.cubecraft.net

CubeCraft is one of the OG Minecraft servers, having been around since 2012. While it does not offer a massive selection of games, it makes up for it with well-designed games like EggWars, SkyWars, Lucky Islands, and parkour, featuring multiple themes. It’s also a great choice if you want to play with friends, as several game modes offer team-based gameplay where you can work together and take on other players.

5. Mineplex

Server IP: mineplex.com (Java), play.mineplex.com, port 19132 (Bedrock)

Mineplex was once one of the most popular Minecraft servers thanks to its mind-boggling selection of games. However, it was shut down in May 2023, which left many in the community disappointed. It was the server that debuted several classic game modes, such as Bridges, Cake Wars, Dragon Escape, and SkyWars. Fortunately, the server returned under new ownership on June 12, 2026, bringing back classic titles and even attracting a peak of around 11,000 players upon its return. The developers have plenty of plans for the future, with seasonal events and regular updates to keep things fresh.

6. Wynncraft

Server IP: play.wynncraft.com

Wynncraft is the Minecraft server to try if you’re looking for the ultimate MMORPG experience. Taking cues from the likes of RuneScape, it features a massive custom-built fantasy world where you can explore different regions, complete quests, battle enemies, and hunt for treasures. The best part about all of this is that you don’t need to install any mods to experience this full-fledged RPG. 2026 has proven to be a major year for Wynncraft, as the developers finally released the Fruma Expansion on April 4, 2026, after seven years of development.

7. DonutSMP

Server IP: donutsmp.net

The final entry on our list of the best Minecraft servers is none other than DonutSMP. The server has gained popularity in the community for its survival gameplay and chaotic PvP battles. You can build your own base, gather resources, and fight other players as you work your way up. With an active community and a steady stream of updates, DonutSMP is a great server if you’re trying to experience the more competitive side of Minecraft.

Which Minecraft server is best for you?

After spending hours playing Minecraft and testing different game modes across servers, we can say that choosing the best Minecraft server ultimately comes down to personal preference. Each server we’ve listed above caters to a specific playstyle and audience. However, if you’re still confused, we’ve also put together a quick list to help you find the right pick:

  • PvP/minigames: If you’re in the mood for competitive modes like Bed Wars and SkyWars, Hypixel and Mineplex are your best bets.
  • Bedrock & mobile: The Hive is an excellent choice for Bedrock players, including those on mobile. It has tons of minigames that can be enjoyed with strangers and friends.
  • RPG: Nothing comes close to the RPG experience you’ll get on Wynncraft. Its extensive quests, dungeons, and character progression make it a great choice for any MMORPG fan.
  • Survival: Love grinding for resources and fighting other players? Well, consider DonutSMP. It’s a server all about survival, progression, and PvP.

How to join a Minecraft server on Java and Bedrock

Joining a Minecraft server is quite easy, but the process depends on whether you’re playing Java Edition on PC or Bedrock Edition on mobile, console, or PC. Before you get started, make sure you have the server’s IP address and port, and check whether it supports your version of Minecraft.

Join a Minecraft server on Java Edition

  1. Fire up Minecraft on your PC and click Multiplayer from the main menu.
  2. Choose Add Server to add a new server to your list.
  3. Enter a server name of your choice and paste its IP address into the Server Address field.
  4. Click Done to save the server.
  5. Select the server from your list and hit Join Server to start playing.

You also have the option of Direct Connection in the multiplayer menu, where you can enter the server address and join instantly without saving it to your list.

Join a Minecraft server on Bedrock Edition

  1. Launch Minecraft and choose Play from the main menu.
  2. Find the Servers tab.
  3. Scroll down and choose Add Server.
  4. Enter the server address and port number if required. The default port is 19132.
  5. Hit Add and Play to connect to the server.

Some featured servers, including The Hive and CubeCraft, can be accessed directly through the Servers tab. On consoles, adding a custom server may be restricted or require additional steps, depending on the platform.

Wrapping up

Minecraft servers offer plenty of ways to enjoy the game beyond single-player, whether you’re into competitive minigames, survival challenges, or full-fledged RPG adventures. Hypixel and MCC Island are great for competitive gameplay, The Hive is a solid choice for Bedrock players, and Wynncraft is worth exploring if you prefer quest-driven RPGs. Meanwhile, DonutSMP offers a more intense survival experience with PvP and player-driven progression.

Ultimately, the best Minecraft server depends on your preferred playstyle and the edition you’re using. Try a few options from this list, explore their game modes, and find the community that suits you best. Just make sure to check the server address and version requirements before joining.

FAQs

Are Minecraft servers free to play?

Most Minecraft servers are free to join and play. However, many servers also offer paid ranks, cosmetics, and other perks that can be purchased with real money.

Can Java and Bedrock players play together?

Java and Bedrock players can play together, but only on servers that support crossplay, such as CubeCraft, Mineplex, and DonutSMP.

What is the best Minecraft server for PvP?

Hypixel is considered one of the best servers for PvP in Minecraft. It’s a great choice if you enjoy competitive matches and battling other players.

Is Mineplex back?

Yes. Mineplex officially returned on June 12, 2026, under new ownership, bringing back classic minigames with support for Java and Bedrock.

What is the most popular Minecraft server?

Hypixel remains one of the most popular Minecraft servers, thanks to its huge selection of minigames and SkyBlock.

What is the best Minecraft server for iPhone?

The Hive is considered the best Minecraft server for iPhone players.

Which Minecraft version should I use for Hypixel?

You can still use Minecraft 1.8.9 for Hypixel’s classic minigames, but SkyBlock now requires Minecraft 1.21.9 or newer.

title.rendered: Apple unveils new iPad Mini with OLED display, A20 Pro chip, and more

content.rendered:
Apple has announced its new iPad mini, bringing the tablet’s biggest upgrade in years with an OLED display, a powerful A20 Pro chip, and a thinner, lighter design. The new model also introduces water and dust resistance, improved cameras, and faster connectivity, making it a more capable option for users who want a compact tablet. It starts at $699, with pre-orders opening on October 28.

iPad Mini gets a bigger OLED display

The new iPad mini features an 8.5-inch OLED display, up from the previous model’s 8.3-inch LCD screen.

Apple says the display delivers deeper blacks, richer colors, and peak brightness of up to 1,200 nits, more than double the previous model. A nano-texture glass option is also available on the 256GB and 512GB models for reducing glare in bright environments. The larger screen fits into the same overall footprint thanks to 24% thinner bezels.

The redesigned tablet measures just 5.4mm thick, compared with 6.3mm for its predecessor, and weighs only 255 grams. It also carries an IP67 rating for water and dust resistance, adding durability for everyday use.

A20 Pro chip brings a performance boost

Apple has equipped the new iPad mini with the A20 Pro chip, which includes Neural Accelerators in each GPU core to support demanding tasks and Apple Intelligence features. The tablet runs iPadOS 27, bringing Apple’s latest software capabilities to the compact device.

Other notable upgrades include a 12MP Center Stage front camera positioned along the landscape edge for video calls, fast charging support (up to 50% in around 30 minutes with a compatible adapter), and an Acoustic Display speaker system that hides the speakers beneath the glass and enclosure.

Apple has also upgraded wireless connectivity with its N1 chip, which supports Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6, and Thread. Cellular models include the C2 modem, which Apple says delivers up to 50% faster cellular data speeds than the previous model.

New iPad Mini price and release date

The new iPad mini starts at $699 for the Wi-Fi model with 128GB of storage, a $100 increase over the previous model’s starting price. The Wi-Fi + Cellular version starts at $849. Buyers have three storage options (128GB, 256GB, and 512GB) and two color choices: Midnight and Starlight.

In India, the new iPad mini is priced from ₹82,900 for the Wi-Fi model and ₹1,00,900 for the Wi-Fi + Cellular model.

Pre-orders open at 10:10 a.m. PT (1:10 p.m. ET) on October 28, 2026, while the tablet will arrive in stores and begin reaching customers on November 6.

Equipped with an OLED screen, an enhanced processor, and increased durability, the new iPad mini offers a substantial refresh for users who want a powerful, easy-to-carry tablet. However, the higher starting price may make buyers weigh whether the display and performance upgrades justify the additional cost.

title.rendered: Doja Cat returns to Fortnite: Here’s how to get the skin

content.rendered:
Popular American singer and rapper Doja Cat has entered the Item Shop in Fortnite once again, drawing a lot of fan attention. As a result, the Doja Cat skin and related cosmetics are among the “best sellers” in the game at the time of writing.

First introduced in October 2025 (Chapter 6 Season 4), these Doja Cat items are up for grabs individually and as part of the Doja Cat Fortnite bundle. Two skins have come out of this crossover, and each costs 1,500 V-Bucks. If you buy them with the bundle, everything together will cost you 3,200 V-Bucks. The offer lasts as long as this particular Fortnite collab is in the Shop, which is until October 30, 5 PM PT or 8 PM ET.

How to get the Doja Cat skin in Fortnite

  1. In Fortnite, go to the Shop tab.
  2. Then, scroll down to the Doja Cat section and select your desired Doja Cat skin.
  3. Once that’s done, press and hold the Purchase button to complete your transaction.

All Doja Cat Bundle items in Fortnite

The main Doja Cat Bundle contains 12 items, including two outfits, pickaxes, back blings, emotes, wraps, a Jam Track, and a loading screen, worth 7,700 V-Bucks if bought separately. A few extras, such as the Lamborghini car body and wheels, are sold outside the bundle. Here’s a breakdown of the items and their individual prices.

1. Doja Cat

  • Price: 1,500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Doja Cat Bundle

2. Mother Of Thorns Doja

  • Price: 1,500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Doja Cat Bundle

3. Agora Wings back bling

  • Price: 300 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Doja Cat Bundle

4. Scarlet Wings back bling

  • Price: 300 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Doja Cat Bundle

5. Doja’s Claw Swords pickaxe

  • Price: 800 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Doja Cat Bundle

6. Mother’s Mic pickaxe and back bling

  • Price: 800 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Doja Cat Bundle

7. Agora Hills emote

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Doja Cat Bundle

8. Woman emote

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Doja Cat Bundle

9. Fallen petals wrap

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Doja Cat Bundle

10. Rhinestoned wrap

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: Doja Cat Bundle

11. Lamborghini Huracan STO car body

Fortnite has kept singer collabs coming regularly in 2026, just as it has over the past few years. This year’s lineup has included many singers making their debut in the game, such as Lil Wayne, Olivia Rodrigo, Madison Beer, Chappell Roan, and Laufey.

Apart from the above, a bunch of previously introduced musician skins were also rotated back into the Item Shop this year, with Icon-tier Fortnite skins such as those inspired by Eminem, Lady Gaga, Billie Eilish, Sabrina Carpenter, and Ice Spice in the mix. And now, with this latest return, Doja Cat joins the list of returning singer-based skins.

With another Fortnite Festival season still to come this year, it’s fair to expect at least one more notable singer to make their way into the game. As of Season 15, which wraps up on October 31, Lil Tecca is headlining the affairs, and according to recent rumors, A$AP Rocky is among the prime suspects for this role next. How long will Doja Cat be in Fortnite?

Doja Cat dropped with the October 25, 8 PM ET / 5 PM PT Shop reset (October 26 in UTC) and will stay in the Shop for roughly five days, until October 30 at 8 PM ET / 5 PM PT (October 31 in UTC).

How to get Doja Cat emote in Fortnite?

To get one of Doja Cat’s emotes (Agora Hills or Woman, 500 V-Bucks each), you have to either purchase it individually or grab the Doja Cat Bundle.

blockGraphs.answer: Doja Cat dropped with the October 25, 8 PM ET / 5 PM PT Shop reset (October 26 in UTC) and will stay in the Shop for roughly five days, until October 30 at 8 PM ET / 5 PM PT (October 31 in UTC).

blockGraphs.question: How to get Doja Cat emote in Fortnite?
blockGraphs.answer: To get one of Doja Cat’s emotes (Agora Hills or Woman, 500 V-Bucks each), you have to either purchase it individually or grab the Doja Cat Bundle.

title.rendered: Instagram tests 90-minute horizontal videos to take on YouTube

content.rendered:
Instagram is making another move into long-form video, and this time, it is targeting podcasters, comedians, and creators who want to share full-length content without sending viewers to another platform. The Meta-owned social network is testing a new format called Features, which supports horizontal videos up to 90 minutes long.

According to The Hollywood Reporter, the test began with select creators in the United States on October 26, 2026, following earlier testing in Brazil. Instagram plans to expand the US test to tens of thousands of creators. The feature could help Instagram compete more directly with YouTube, particularly as video podcasts and creator-led entertainment continue to attract audiences.

Instagram wants viewers to watch full-length videos

Features is designed to bridge the gap between Instagram’s short-form Reels and longer videos. Creators can connect shorter Reels to their full-length videos, allowing viewers to discover a clip and continue watching the complete episode without leaving Instagram.

The platform also plans to recommend these longer videos on the Explore page and elsewhere in the app. This approach would let creators capitalize on the success of their viral clips and create longer viewing experiences without viewers having to leave Instagram.

The move addresses the time limitation of Reels, which typically run around three minutes or less, and opens the door to full podcast episodes, comedy specials, interviews, and other long-form productions. Early creators involved in the test include podcast host and SKIMS co-founder Emma Grede, beauty creator Monet McMichael, street interviewer Preston Rakovsky, and football content creator Donald De La Haye.

In addition, Instagram is looking for ways to help creators earn money from this content through existing brand partnerships and sponsored placements. However, the company has not yet established a YouTube-style revenue-sharing model for this new format.

Instagram is expanding beyond smartphones

The Features test arrives as Instagram broadens its video strategy beyond mobile devices. The company recently introduced its dedicated Apple TV app, letting users watch Reels and other video content on a larger screen and making its content part of the living-room entertainment experience.

Features will start on mobile, but Instagram’s longer-term plan is to bring these videos to its TV app as well.

With longer videos, television support, and enhanced features for discovering content, Instagram seems to be moving beyond being just a social media app.
