title.rendered: How to check Activation Lock before buying a used Apple device

content.rendered:
If you’re planning to buy a used Apple device, there’s one step you should never skip: checking its Activation Lock status. If it’s turned on, you won’t be able to use the device without the previous owner’s Apple Account credentials.

Keep reading, and I’ll show you how to check Activation Lock before buying a used iPhone, iPad, Mac, or Apple Watch. I’ll also share what to do if the device is iCloud-locked.

What exactly is Activation Lock on Apple devices?

Activation Lock is a security feature that’s part of Apple’s Find My service, and it stops anyone else from using your device. It turns on automatically when you set up Find My on your device. Apple stores your Apple Account on its activation servers and links it to that device.

After that, anyone who wants to turn off Find My, erase the device, or reactivate and use it needs the original Apple Account and password (or, on iPhone and iPad, the device passcode). This makes a lost or stolen Apple device practically useless to anyone except its owner.

Activation Lock also stays on even if you remotely erase your device, as long as Find My isn’t turned off. Every time someone tries to activate the device, it checks with Apple’s servers and asks for the owner’s credentials. This also improves your chances of getting a lost or stolen Apple device back.

Note: AirPods, AirTag, and other Find My accessories can also be locked to an Apple Account. If you’re buying used AirPods, ask the seller to remove them from the Find My app or iCloud.com/find first. Apple can’t remove this lock for you.

Why check the Activation Lock status before buying a used Apple device?

Apple’s advice is simple: if the device is Activation Locked, don’t buy it. Checking the status upfront helps you:

  • Avoid buying a stolen device: A device that’s still locked could be lost or stolen.
  • Make sure you can use it: You can’t set up or activate a locked device.
  • Get a fresh start: A properly erased device has no old accounts or data on it.
  • Avoid scams: Some sellers don’t mention that the device is still linked to their account, and only offer to remove it later for an extra fee.

Besides Activation Lock, there are a few other things to check, especially on a used iPhone. See our checklist of things to check before buying a used iPhone for more details.

Where you buy also matters. If you’re looking for a refurbished iPhone, our guide to the best places to buy a refurbished iPhone can help.

How to check the Activation Lock status on iPhone or iPad

You need the device in hand, because Apple no longer offers a way to check Activation Lock remotely. Here are three ways to check it on a used iPhone or iPad (the same steps work on an older iPod touch).

Method 1: During setup

Turn on the device or wake it up and If you see any of the following alerts…

Activation Lock is turned on:

  • iPhone Locked to Owner: Activation Lock is on (iOS/iPadOS 15 or later). Don’t buy the device.
  • Hello screen: The device has been erased and is ready to set up. Go ahead and set it up with your own Apple Account.
  • If setup later asks for the previous owner’s Apple Account and password, the device is still linked to their account. Don’t buy it until the seller removes it.

Method 2: From the Lock Screen

  1. Turn on the device.
  2. If you see a Lock Screen asking for a passcode, or the Home Screen, the device hasn’t been erased yet.
  3. Ask the seller to factory reset it in front of you.
  4. After it’s erased, start the setup.
  5. If you’re asked for the previous owner’s Apple Account and password, Activation Lock is still on.

Method 3: Using Find My settings

  1. If the device is already set up, open the Settings app.
  2. Tap Apple Account at the top and select Find My.

  3. Here, tap on Find My iPhone (or iPad/iPod Touch). If Find My is turned on, Activation Lock is also enabled.

  4. Ask the seller to turn it off, sign out of their Apple Account, and erase the device before you pay.

Tip: If the seller has Stolen Device Protection turned on, they may need Face ID or Touch ID to make these changes. If they’re away from a familiar location, some actions, like signing out of their Apple Account, can also need a one-hour security delay. Plan the handover with that in mind.

While you’re in Settings, also go to General → About → Parts and Service History. Apple says Activation Lock can protect individual parts too. A part listed as “Unknown” may be non-genuine or taken from another iPhone.

How to check the Activation Lock status on a used Mac

Like iPhone, a Mac turns on Activation Lock when Find My Mac is turned on. It’s supported on Macs with Apple silicon or the Apple T2 Security Chip running macOS Catalina or later, when two-factor authentication is on for the Apple Account. Here’s how to check:

  1. Click the Apple menu () and choose About This Mac.
  2. Click More Info, then scroll down and click System Report. (You can also hold the Option key and choose Apple menu → System Information.)
  3. In Hardware Overview, look at Activation Lock Status.

Buy the Mac only if it says Disabled.

You can also go to System Settings → [seller’s name] → iCloud and check whether Find My Mac is on.

If the Mac has already been erased, start the setup. If you see an Activation Lock screen asking for an Apple Account, don’t buy the Mac until the seller removes it from their account.

How to check Activation Lock status for a used Apple Watch

You can also go to System Settings → [seller’s name] → iCloud and check whether Find My Mac is on.

If the Mac has already been erased, start the setup. If you see an Activation Lock screen asking for an Apple Account, don’t buy the Mac until the seller removes it from their account.

How to check Activation Lock status on a used Apple Watch

When you pair an Apple Watch with an iPhone that has Find My turned on, Activation Lock turns on for the watch too.

  1. Turn on the Apple Watch. If you see the watch face, apps, or a passcode screen, it hasn’t been erased yet. Ask the seller to unpair it from their iPhone, which turns off Activation Lock and erases the watch.
  2. Try pairing the watch with your iPhone. If setup asks for the previous owner’s Apple Account password, Activation Lock is still on, and you can’t use the watch.
  3. For cellular models, also make sure the seller has removed and cancelled their cellular plan.

What to do if the device is iCloud locked?

If you find out that a device you’re buying, or already bought, is Activation Locked, here’s what to do:

  • Check for Lost Mode: If the screen shows a lost message or the owner’s contact details, the device may be stolen. Don’t buy it.
  • Ask the seller to remove it remotely: They can sign in at iCloud.com/find with the Apple Account shown on the screen, select the device, and click Remove This Device. They can also do this from the Find My app on another device.
  • Apple Watch: Ask the seller to unpair it in the Watch app, or remove it from Find My.
  • Seller forgot their password: They can reset it at iforgot.apple.com. The original owner can also submit an Activation Lock support request to Apple with proof of purchase (Apple’s Activation Lock removal page).
  • Walk away if the seller won’t unlock it. The device may be stolen.
  • Report suspicious listings to the marketplace or local authorities.

For more details, see our guide on what to do if your iPhone or iPad is stuck on Activation Lock.

Signing off…

Checking Activation Lock before buying a used iPhone, iPad, Mac, or Apple Watch takes a minute and can save you from a device you can’t use. Make sure Find My is turned off and the previous owner has removed their Apple Account before you pay. If Activation Lock is still on, walk away. It’s not worth the risk.

FAQs

How can I bypass the Activation Lock on my iPhone?

You cannot legally bypass Activation Lock. Apple designed it as a security feature to prevent stolen devices from being used. The only way to remove it is by entering the original Apple Account and password. If you forgot your Apple Account, visit Apple’s official recovery page.

Does factory resetting remove the Activation Lock?

No. Factory resetting does not remove the Activation Lock from an Apple device. Even if you erase the device, it will still ask for the previous owner’s Apple Account and password during setup. Activation Lock can only be disabled by turning off Find My iPhone before erasing the device.

You may find these helpful:

  • 25 Essential tips for first-time iPhone users
  • How to check if iPhone is original or not
  • How to check trade-in value of iPhone, Apple Watch, and Mac

  • Apple Magic Keyboard with Numeric Keypad
  • Apple Magic Trackpad
  • Kensington SD5900T Thunderbolt 4 Dock
  • Anker 5-in-1 USB-C Hub
  • UGREEN Nexode 65W GaN Charger
  • Lamicall Aluminum Laptop Stand

mainEntity.name: How can I bypass the Activation Lock on my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: You cannot legally bypass Activation Lock. Apple designed it as a security feature to prevent stolen devices from being used. The only way to remove it is by entering the original Apple Account and password. If you forgot your Apple Account, visit Apple's official recovery page.

mainEntity.name: Does factory resetting remove the Activation Lock?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Factory resetting does not remove the Activation Lock from an Apple device. Even if you erase the device, it will still ask for the previous owner’s Apple Account and password during setup. Activation Lock can only be disabled by turning off Find My iPhone before erasing the device.

About Dhvanesh

Ever since teenage years, gadgets and technology have held a special place in Dhvanesh's heart. This fascination with gadgets and their inner workings fueled a lifelong passion for exploration and troubleshooting. Disassembled electronic items scattered around the house became a familiar sight during his younger years, a testament to this insatiable curiosity.

From SEO Expert to Apple Evangelist

After completing his IT engineering diploma, Dhvanesh's professional journey began with a 4.5-year stint as an SEO executive, honing valuable digital marketing skills. However, the desire to share tech knowledge and connect with a like-minded community proved stronger. In 2012, Dhvanesh embarked on a new adventure, founding iGeeksBlog. This blog became a haven for Apple enthusiasts and tech aficionados seeking insightful and in-depth information about everything Apple.

A Decade of iGeeksBlog: Leading the Apple Charge

In the past 12 years, Dhvanesh has donned multiple hats at iGeeksBlog. As the founder, he has steered the blog’s vision, ensuring it remains a trusted resource for Apple users worldwide. Additionally, he has been serving as the CEO of iGeeks Media Private Limited for the past 4 years, overseeing the company's growth and development.

Beyond Writing: A Multifaceted Approach

Dhvanesh isn't just a prolific writer, having penned hundreds of articles for iGeeksBlog. He has also served as the blog’s Editor-in-Chief and Content Strategist, ensuring a consistent flow of high-quality content that caters to the diverse needs of the Apple user base. The passion for exploration extends beyond the written word. He has created numerous YouTube videos for iGeeksBlog, providing visual demonstrations and engaging directly with the audience.

Staying Connected with the Apple Ecosystem

Currently, he also manages the iGeeksBlog+ weekly newsletter, delivering curated Apple news, gadgets, apps, tips and tricks straight to subscribers' inboxes. This unwavering commitment to Apple technology and a genuine desire to empower fellow users make him a valuable asset to the iGeeksBlog team.

title.rendered: iPhone Duo display cracked or showing a white line? Here’s what to do

content.rendered:
The iPhone Duo’s new foldable display has raised concerns after some users reported cracks near the hinge shortly after its October 23 launch. Some have also noticed white lines and pixel issues on the inner screen, raising questions about the phone’s durability.

Apple hasn’t confirmed the cause or how widespread the issue is yet. If you’ve just bought a Duo, here’s what I’d look out for and what I’d do if it happened to my phone. The good news is that if a manufacturing defect caused the crack, Apple’s one-year limited warranty may cover it, so don’t rush into paying for a repair.

What is the “Crackgate” issue with the iPhone Duo display?

On Reddit, several owners reported cracks appearing along the center crease, with a horizontal block of pixels glowing white. In some cases, it happened right during setup, making people wonder if just folding the phone would be enough to make this happen.

The investigation is becoming more interesting because the display itself may not be the cause. In my iPhone Duo hinge teardown report, I already discussed how certain components could put excessive pressure on the delicate inner display. Dust entering the hinge and potential stress points around its internal components have also attracted attention.

However, further investigation hasn’t established that all the cracks have the same origin. According to Apple, “We are aware of an issue impacting the inner display on a small number of iPhone Duo units. If users experience issues with their iPhone Duo display, they should contact AppleCare for a replacement.”

For owners, the immediate concern is simpler: a damaged folding display can be expensive to replace. So don’t panic if your phone works normally, but watch for unusual hinge noises, visible cracks, flickering, or bright lines across the screen.

What to do immediately if your iPhone Duo display is cracked

If you notice a crack or display defect, avoid experimenting with the phone to determine how bad the problem is. Here’s how I’d handle the situation.

1. Stop folding and unfolding the phone

My first move would be to stop opening and closing the iPhone Duo unnecessarily. Apple’s official iPhone Duo hinge troubleshooting guide also recommends checking for hinge problems such as unusual noises, stiffness, misalignment, and visible damage.

Do not force the hinge if it feels stiff, makes an unusual clicking or cracking sound, or refuses to close completely. Apple’s handling guidance mainly focuses on keeping sand and grit away from the hinge, but you should also avoid pressing directly on the display crease or forcing the two halves together.

Keep the phone on a stable surface when you are not using it. If the white line is getting worse, the hinge looks damaged, or the device gets unusually hot, stop using it and get in touch with Apple.

2. Document the damage

While preparing to contact Apple, make sure you take photographs of the cracked iPhone Duo screen. Include photos of the central crease, the entire inner screen, the outer screen, and the hinge from multiple angles. If you notice bright white or green lines, flickering, or dead pixels, photograph those symptoms too.

I would also record a short video if the display defect changes or flickers, as long as I can do so without repeatedly moving the hinge. Keep your purchase receipt, order confirmation, and any relevant service records.

When speaking with Apple Support, describe exactly what happened. For example, explain whether the crack appeared during normal use, whether you dropped the phone, or whether you heard a cracking noise from the hinge.

3. Back up your iPhone data

A cracked screen does not necessarily mean your phone will stop working right away. But internal damage might cause problems that make it hard to access your data.

If the screen is still usable, back up your iPhone Duo to iCloud or a compatible computer. Wait until the backup finishes before you send the phone in.

4. Avoid DIY repairs and screen protector removal

Even though Apple has published official iPhone Duo repair documentation, I wouldn’t recommend opening the device or attempting an inner-display repair.

First of all, foldable displays are especially fragile, and the hinge complicates things. Pulling at the display, inserting tools into the hinge, or pressing on the crease could turn a minor issue into a more expensive repair.

Do not peel off the inner display’s cover layer simply because it looks damaged. The protective layer is not the same thing as the underlying display. Also, keep the hinge away from sand and loose debris, and use a soft, lint-free cloth to clean accessible surfaces.

One thing to know: Apple says hinge issues don’t have software-based fixes, so restarting, updating, or restoring your iPhone won’t fix a mechanical hinge problem. If the display is cracked or the hinge appears damaged, arrange a professional inspection.

How to get your cracked iPhone Duo repaired or replaced

Contact Apple Support first rather than going straight to an independent repair shop. Explain the symptoms, when they started, and whether the phone has experienced any impact or unusual hinge behavior. Then follow their recommendations.

The next step is visiting either an Apple Store or an Apple Authorized Service Provider, depending on availability in your area. Ask the technician to inspect the inner display and hinge, and ask whether the device qualifies for warranty service or a replacement.

Will Apple replace a cracked iPhone Duo for free? It’s possible, but nothing is certain. Apple’s limited warranty generally covers qualifying manufacturing defects, while accidental damage is treated differently. The final decision depends on the inspection, the applicable warranty terms, and the cause of the failure.

Early reports indicate that some affected owners obtained replacement devices through Apple Stores, although other buyers had difficulty. If you bought the device through a mobile carrier or another retailer, contact AppleCare directly to get your device replaced.

How much does it cost to fix a cracked iPhone Duo display?

The cost is one of the biggest reasons to seek a proper diagnosis before authorizing a repair. According to Apple’s iPhone Duo out-of-warranty repair costs, the repair estimates are as follows:

The difference is substantial. An inner-display replacement costs $999 without AppleCare+, while the listed AppleCare+ service fee is $99 for qualifying damage. AppleCare+ is a separate paid plan ($19.99 a month, $199.99 a year, or $399 upfront for AppleCare+ with Theft and Loss in the US), so you should also consider its cost when comparing the total expense.

However, Apple says AppleCare+ is not required to have your iPhone Duo replaced for this problem

My advice is straightforward: if your iPhone Duo develops a crack during normal use, start with a warranty assessment. Paying nearly $1,000 for a replacement without determining the cause shouldn’t be the first step.

What should you do if the screen is not cracked but shows a white line?

A white line across the iPhone Duo display can be alarming, especially if the phone hasn’t been dropped. The problem may involve the display panel, its internal connections, or another hardware fault. A visible line alone is not enough to identify the cause.

Start by observing the symptom without repeatedly folding the phone. Check whether the line remains visible across different apps and screens. If the device is otherwise safe to use, a normal restart may help rule out a temporary software glitch.

If the line persists, grows, flickers, or appears alongside touch-response problems, arrange a professional inspection. If you also hear a snapping sound or notice unusual hinge movement, stop operating the hinge and contact Apple.

Most importantly, don’t wait for a white line to become a complete display failure before seeking help. Early documentation and a timely service assessment can make the next steps easier.

Final thoughts

The early iPhone Duo display failures are concerning, but I would not conclude that all devices have a faulty hinge based on a limited number of reports. The cause, scale, and long-term implications still need to be established.

If your iPhone Duo screen has cracked, stop folding it, document the damage, back up your data, and contact Apple before agreeing to a paid repair. With an out-of-warranty inner-display replacement listed at $999 in the US, getting the diagnosis right matters.

A premium folding phone should not leave its owner guessing whether normal use will damage the screen. Until Apple clarifies the reported failures, focus on protecting the device, preserving evidence, and seeking warranty options before spending another dollar.

mainEntity.name: How can I bypass the Activation Lock on my iPhone?

acceptedAnswer.text: You cannot legally bypass Activation Lock. Apple designed it as a security feature to prevent stolen devices from being used. The only way to remove it is by entering the original Apple Account and password. If you forgot your Apple Account, visit Apple's official recovery page.

mainEntity.name: Does factory resetting remove the Activation Lock?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Factory resetting does not remove the Activation Lock from an Apple device. Even if you erase the device, it will still ask for the previous owner’s Apple Account and password during setup. Activation Lock can only be disabled by turning off Find My iPhone before erasing the device.

Anime Ball Duels is a Roblox experience that brings a unique twist to competitive gameplay. So, what’s so special about it? Well, it brings ball battles with your favorite anime characters. You’ll be going head-to-head against other players, relying on smart timing, quick movements, and special abilities to claim victory.

However, progressing through the game requires tons of resources, including Coins, Gems, Trait Crystals, and more. Luckily, we’ve gathered a list of all the working Anime Ball Duels codes that can get you these resources for free, and we update it regularly, so you never miss a new one!

All working Anime Ball Duels codes

  • WEAREBACK: 15,000 Coins, 1,000 Gems, 50 Trait Rolls, 2,000 Candy Corn, and 10 Spins (NEW)
  • HACKERSLOST: 7,500 Coins, 500 Gems, 25 Trait Rolls, 1,000 Candy Corn, and 5 Spins (NEW)
  • EXTENDED: 250 Gems, 5 Trait Rolls, 500 Candy Corn, and 3 Boss Tickets (NEW)

As of now, these are the only active Anime Ball Duels codes available. Make sure to redeem them as soon as possible, as codes can expire without warning, leaving you unable to claim their rewards.

Expired Anime Ball Duels codes

1MVISITS, 2VS2, 67PATHS, BATTLEPASS, BUGFIXESSHUTDOWN, CHATSHUTDOWN, HALLOWEEN2026, KOKUSHIBONPCISHERE, LASTHALLOWEENSHUTDOWN, LASTLASTSHUTDOWN, NEWSHUTDOWN, SECRETBOOSTERCODE1234, SORRYFORSHUTDOWN, SORRYSHUTDOWN, UPDATE1, VOID, WEWANTCANDYCORN

How to redeem Anime Ball Duels in Roblox

title.rendered: Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5: New advancement, Packed Ice Bricks & more

content.rendered:
Mojang released Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5 on October 20, 2026, bringing a bunch of new winter-themed content to Java Edition. But what makes this snapshot worth checking out? Well, not only does it bring new blocks, but it also adds a new advancement, ambient sounds, gameplay tweaks, technical changes, and plenty of other things for players to explore.

So, if you’re excited, here’s everything you need to know about Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5, including all the new features and how to install it safely.

What’s new in Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5?

Packed Ice Bricks

The highlight of Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5 is Packed Ice Bricks. This is a new building block that gives players more ways to decorate their builds. Unlike regular packed ice, these bricks aren’t slippery, which makes them quite useful for designing houses. You can craft them by putting down four Packed Ice blocks in a 2×2 crafting grid.

The set comes with four variants for you to use:

  • Packed Ice Brick Slab
  • Packed Ice Brick Stairs
  • Packed Ice Brick Wall
  • Chiseled Packed Ice

You can also make the slabs, stairs, walls and chiseled block in a Stonecutter. To collect them, use a pickaxe (no Silk Touch needed, unlike other ice blocks), or even your bare hands, though that’s slower. So, collecting them shouldn’t be much of a hassle.

New advancement: What goes around comes around

There’s also a new Adventure advancement called “What Goes Around Comes Around”. In order to obtain it, you need to kill a Frostbite with an Ice Ball. These projectiles can be easily obtained by defeating Frostbites, which spawn in ice caves and cold biomes. You can also encounter them when regular zombies get submerged in powder snow, which gives you another way to find these mobs.

Ice now has ambient sounds

Tired of Minecraft’s icy environments feeling a bit too quiet? Mojang has added ambient sounds for regular Ice blocks to make these areas feel even more alive. However, the sounds only have a chance of playing under certain conditions. An Ice block must have at least eight Ice blocks surrounding it horizontally, a Water block underneath, and an Air block right above it.

Mob projectiles can break blocks in Adventure mode

Mobs have also received a small change in Adventure mode. Their projectiles can now break certain blocks, including Decorated Pots, Chorus Flowers, and Speleothems. This could prove to be trouble if you’re trying to protect a build from hostile mobs. However, you can prevent this behavior by setting the mob_griefing gamerule to false.

New “Prefer DXGI Present” video setting (Windows)

Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5 also introduces a new Prefer DXGI Present option, which can be found in the Video Settings menu. It’s available exclusively for Windows players, and it lets the game attempt to use DirectX to present the game. This means systems can benefit from better Variable Refresh Rate compatibility, improved IME support, and faster Alt+Tab switching when playing in fullscreen mode. Keep in mind that it’s off by default, Mojang labels it experimental, and not all hardware supports it.

Is Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5 available on Bedrock?

Unfortunately, Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5 is not available on Bedrock. Bedrock has its own separate testing track, with Preview 26.70.21 playable right now, which brings its own set of features and changes, including Packed Ice Bricks.

How to install Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5 (Mac and Windows)

In order to install Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5 on your Mac or Windows PC, you’ll first need Java Edition. Once that’s done, follow these steps:

  1. Open the Minecraft Launcher on your Mac or Windows PC and log in to your account.
  2. Head to the Installations tab at the top of the launcher and enable Snapshots.
  3. Click New Installation, enter a name for your build, and select 26.4-snapshot-5 from the version dropdown menu.
  4. Choose Create, select your installation, and press Play to launch the snapshot.

Once you hit Play, the launcher will automatically download the files needed to run the snapshot. However, make sure to back up your existing worlds before playing, as snapshots are experimental versions that can contain bugs or corrupt your existing worlds. Also, if you’re using the Vulkan renderer, avoid resizing the game window, as this snapshot has a known issue that can crash the game.

When will Minecraft 26.4 release?

As of now, there’s no exact release date for Minecraft 26.4. However, it’s expected that the update will arrive right before the end of 2026, as it’s being projected as the final game drop of the year. Until Mojang announces the official date, players need to wait for further snapshots and a pre-release version to get a better idea of when the next version will launch.

FAQs

Is Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5 free?

Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5 is free for players who already own a copy of Minecraft Java Edition. You can download and play it through the official launcher without paying anything extra.

Can I play snapshots on iPhone or iPad?

You can’t play Minecraft snapshots on iPhone or iPad. These builds are exclusive to Java Edition, which is available on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

Do Packed Ice Bricks melt?

Packed Ice Bricks do not melt when exposed to light or warm conditions.

Can I use my old world?

You can use your existing world to explore Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 5. However, as snapshots are experimental and can carry bugs, make sure to create a backup of your world first.

What’s the next snapshot?

There’s no official release date for Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 6 as of now.

  • Best Minecraft servers

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Factory resetting does not remove the Activation Lock from an Apple device. title.rendered: All 10 Safety In Numbers quests and rewards in Fortnite

content.rendered:
Fortnite’s community-developed maps might not be backed by the game dev wizards at Epic Games, but many of them are no slouch when it comes to drawing the attention of players. However, if you still haven’t explored the unofficial maps in Fortnite, the Safety in Numbers lineup of quests might just be the perfect excuse to change that, and to bring a friend along for the ride.

The Safety in Numbers quests in Fortnite require players to jump into Horror Creator-made Islands or maps with at least one friend in their party and earn XP doing various activities in them. This XP counts toward certain milestones, and completing them makes you eligible for a total of 5 different Safety in Numbers rewards. The quests are available until November 12, 2026, at 6 AM ET (3 AM PT), so you have a little over two weeks left to grind them.

Speaking of Horror Creator-made Islands, which is another name for community-made horror games in Fortnite, let’s check out how you can load them in Fortnite before we get to the Safety in Numbers quest and reward checklist.

How to play Horror Creator-made Fortnite Islands

  1. In Fortnite, go to the Discover tab.
  2. Then, scroll down until you reach the Game Collections section, and select the Thrills & Chills category.
  3. Next, select any map of your choice from the options that appear.
  4. Now, hit Select to switch to the desired map.
  5. Finally, select Play to launch the Horror Creator-made Fortnite Island.

Tip: The Safety in Numbers quests only show up in the Quests tab once a qualifying horror map is selected. If you can’t see them, select a horror island first, then check the Quests tab.

Safety In Numbers quests and rewards list

The Safety in Numbers quests are divided into 10 stages, each asking you to collect 80,000 XP in eligible Fortnite maps. Completing each stage gives you 10,000 XP as a reward, and every second stage also unlocks a cosmetic reward, as listed below.

Once you have unlocked any of these rewards, don’t forget to claim them in time. As soon as you claim an item, it will start appearing in your Locker tab and can be equipped for Fortnite matches.

Popular Horror Creator-made maps in Fortnite

If you are ready to jump into this challenge and unlock the quest rewards above, you may try some of the more popular Horror Creator-made Fortnite Islands. Here are the ones drawing noteworthy levels of player engagement, along with their codes:

  • Scale | Code: 7288-9515-0748
  • Hide Or Die | Code: 6386-2237-2556
  • Jump For Eggs | Code: 3501-7237-8602
  • Murder Mystery | Code: 5253-8468-3364
  • Trick, Treat, Die! | Code: 9279-9186-3094

All the aforementioned Fortnite maps offer XP that counts toward the Safety in Numbers questline. So, you can either mix and match between these maps to collect the required XP or grind one specific map of your choice. It adds to your quest progress either way.

Don’t miss these related reads:

  • Stalkboxes in Fortnite: What they do and how to find them
  • How to get the Jack-O’-Cat sidekick in Fortnite before it leaves
  • How to unlock and find Finger Guns in Fortnite
  • The Final Spritemare full schedule

title.rendered: iPhone Duo screen cracks may be linked to hinge design, teardown reveals

content.rendered:
Apple’s first foldable iPhone is facing early durability concerns after reports of cracks and display failures on its inner screen appeared on Reddit within hours of the October 23 release. While early device failures can happen with major product launches, the consistency in how the inner display is cracking has raised concerns about a possible underlying issue.

Teardowns by repair specialists at iFixit and some YouTubers have identified potential problems with the hinge mechanism that could put excessive pressure on the delicate folding display. However, the exact cause remains unconfirmed, and the extent of the problem is still unclear.

Is the iPhone Duo hinge causing the screen cracks?

Videos, including testing by JerryRigEverything, and user reports show a recurring pattern: cracks often begin along the display’s crease and spread horizontally toward the edge. While this initially suggests that the screen itself is failing under bending stress, a separate investigation by YouTuber CuriousHagi points to a possible hinge defect.

During testing involving dirt and stress on the folding mechanism, CuriousHagi found that the iPhone Duo would not close properly. When he tried opening it again, a loud snap occurred, followed by a large white display defect extending from the crease toward the side.

After dismantling the damaged device, he discovered a sheared hinge component near an upper support plate. It looked thinner than other hinge components, which might make it more prone to breakage.

These observations suggest that a hinge component may have broken, struck the screen, and caused the crack. However, this remains a theory based on an individual teardown, not a confirmed explanation for every reported failure.

You may like to read: What to do immediately if your iPhone Duo display is cracked

iFixit teardown shows a similar hinge problem

According to iFixit, some reported display failures appear near the hinge, close to the opening through which a flex cable connects the phone’s two halves. Using teardown footage, Apple patents, and CT scans, the team created a 3D model of the hinge and identified two possible problems.

First, a central support bar might not retract far enough when the phone folds shut, potentially pressing against the inner display. Second, the curved rails guiding the hinge’s movement could rise above surrounding components during folding, creating pressure points that may damage the screen.

These are possible causes of “Crackgate,” but none has been proven. Repeated bending, dust particles, manufacturing defects, or broken electrical connections could also cause screen failure.

iFixit also gave the iPhone Duo a provisional 5/10 repairability score, but flagged the inner display and hinge as the hardest parts to fix. Apple charges $999 to replace the inner screen out of warranty.

Dust exposure raises additional concerns

The iPhone Duo has also struggled in durability testing. In JerryRigEverything’s test, dust reportedly entered the hinge through several openings and overwhelmed the magnets designed to hold the phone shut. During the subsequent bend test, a permanent green line appeared across the inner display before the screen became unresponsive.

Interestingly, iFixit’s separate fluorescent dust test also found particles entering the hinge and producing a crunching sound during operation. However, the iPhone Duo showed less visible dust around its hinge than the Samsung Galaxy Z Fold 8 Ultra and Pixel 11 Pro Fold in comparable tests.

The iPhone Duo carries an IP68 rating, which indicates protection against dust and water under specified test conditions. However, this does not guarantee that its moving components are immune to particles or mechanical wear.

Should owners be worried?

The reports do not establish that the iPhone Duo has a widespread design flaw. AppleInsider’s initial checks at seven Apple Store locations found no broken-screen cases, though a later check found one instance. These limited observations cannot determine the device’s overall failure rate.

For now, owners should keep debris away from the hinge and contact Apple if they hear odd noises or see cracks or any other signs of damage on their screens.

Ultimately, the teardown findings raise legitimate questions about the iPhone Duo’s long-term durability, but further investigations are needed to determine whether these incidents are isolated or indicate a broader problem.

title.rendered: Instagram launches Apple TV app with Reels, longer videos, and live shows

content.rendered:
Instagram has finally come to Apple TV, debuting a dedicated app for Apple’s streaming box. The new app brings Instagram Reels, longer videos, and live shows to the TV, letting users watch their favorite creators on a bigger screen and enjoy content with friends and family.

According to Apple’s TV-specific App Store release data, the app was first released on October 23, 2026, as version 66.0, with no official announcement from Meta. An archived listing from October 19 did not include Apple TV compatibility. The app needs at least tvOS 26.0 and can be downloaded from the Apple TV App Store.

Instagram comes to the big screen

The new Instagram app is designed primarily for watching video content rather than recreating every feature of the mobile experience. You can discover Reels, watch longer videos and shows, follow your favorite creators, and resume watching across supported screens.

According to Meta, the TV experience is positioned as a way to watch content together. Instead of passing a phone around, users can enjoy entertaining videos on their living room TV with friends and family.

The Apple TV launch follows Instagram’s broader expansion. The company began testing its TV experience on Amazon Fire TV devices in the United States in December 2025. It then expanded to Google TV in February 2026 and Samsung smart TVs in June.

Building on Instagram’s TV experience

In June 2026, Meta announced new features it was testing for Instagram for TV, including a dedicated home for horizontal videos, channels organized around your interests, and casting Reels from your phone to the TV. It also said it was exploring new formats such as longer creator videos, episodic series, and Live on TV. The Apple TV app’s listing already mentions longer videos and live shows, though Meta only confirmed casting for Google TV and Fire TV at the time.

However, the Apple TV app isn’t a complete substitute for Instagram on your iPhone. Its primary purpose is video discovery and playback, so you shouldn’t expect every feature from the mobile app to be available in the TV interface.

How to get Instagram on Apple TV

You can download Instagram directly from the Apple TV App Store. The app is free to download, although Instagram offers in-app purchases. To install it, you need an Apple TV running tvOS 26.0 or later, which covers the Apple TV HD and every Apple TV 4K model. The app is rated 13+ and includes parental controls, which is worth setting up on a shared family TV.

The launch gives Instagram another way to reach audiences beyond mobile devices. As Meta continues developing more viewing experiences, Apple TV could become an important part of its strategy to make Instagram a more social, living-room-friendly video platform.

title.rendered: Stalkboxes in Fortnite: What they do and how to find them

content.rendered:
Since their introduction in October 2025, Stalkboxes are starting to become a Fortnitemares staple and have proven useful for getting your hands on the Last Call mythic item. While they were more prominent in last year’s Halloween-themed event, this year they have been limited to a single map in Fortnite Reload: Nitemare Island.

Despite not being as prevalent in the game as last year, Stalkboxes are still an unskippable part of the “Reload: Nitemare Two” set of quests in Fortnite Reload. With that said, you can read more about what a Stalkbox does, where you can find one, and how you can tell if one’s nearby.

What does a Stalkbox do in Fortnite?

A Stalkbox is a telephone booth-like kiosk that your player character can use to acquire the Scream-inspired Last Call mythic item. This particular item is a weapon-cum-tracker of sorts, as it helps you mark nearby enemies for a brief period and slash through them using Ghost Face’s knife.

Notably, your appearance also changes into that of the iconic Scream antagonist whenever you switch to this item.

Besides giving you a gameplay advantage, using a Stalkbox also ticks off the “Pick up the phone at a Stalkbox” quest, which rewards you with 15,000 XP. Moreover, it counts towards the 26 Fortnitemares quests you must complete to unlock the Jack-A-Nape skin.

Where to find a Stalkbox in Fortnite?

Last year, Fortnite maps across different modes, including Battle Royale, were littered with Stalkboxes, and it was easy to find one. However, in Fortnitemares 2026, they are restricted to Nitemare Island in Fortnite Reload.

Since this mode features a map rotation that happens roughly every 20 minutes, and because there are three different Reload maps in the loop currently (Nitemare Island, Squid Grounds and Stranger Things), you may have to wait for some time before you can start your search for a Stalkbox.

Also note that the Nitemare Two quests stay locked until you complete at least one Reload: Nitemare One quest.

How to find Stalkboxes in Fortnite Reload’s Nitemare Island

This year, Stalkboxes seem to be spawning randomly on Nitemare Island, so there are no fixed locations where you can find them. But there are certain named POIs where they have been spotted more often, and there are certain cues you must pay attention to so you don’t miss a Stalkbox when it’s nearby.

Some of the recommended locations for encountering a Stalkbox are Terror Turrets, Retail Ruin, and Punishment Patch. More or less, these booths generally appear in denser areas such as residential neighborhoods instead of open spaces. Regardless of which POI you are in, if you are close to a Stalkbox, you will hear a loud phone-ringing sound, and the booth also has a flashing light. You can use that as an audio guide to close in on your target.

Rounding up

Even though Stalkboxes did return in Fortnitemares for a second consecutive year, this time they haven’t been incorporated into the game as much as last time. That’s mainly because their main purpose, which is to give the player the Last Call item, was made redundant by that very mythic weapon becoming a Loot Hack instead, a novel feature that didn’t exist when Stalkboxes and Last Call were first released.

Nevertheless, including Stalkboxes in one of the Fortnitemares quests was the devs’ move to keep the ominous-looking kiosk relevant, even if only by a bit. Keep in mind that the quest has to be completed before Fortnitemares ends on November 1. It will be interesting to see if this continues to be the case or if Stalkboxes return to their former glory next October, with Fortnitemares 2027.

FAQs

Are Stalkboxes in Fortnite Battle Royale in 2026?

No, Stalkboxes are not available in any of the Battle Royale modes outside Reload this year.

Do Stalkboxes appear in every Fortnite Reload match?

No, Stalkboxes don’t appear in every Fortnite Reload match. They only appear in matches where the Nitemare Island map is active. Moreover, they may not always spawn in the same spot on that map either.

Do I need to complete the Stalkbox quest for the Jack-A-Nape skin?

You don’t specifically need this particular quest completed to unlock Jack-A-Nape, since 27 quests are available against the 26 required. But since the quest becomes available rather early and is also quite easy, most players would have completed it to meet the objective.

title.rendered: Nikki from Obsession comes to Fortnite: Price, how to buy, bundle details

content.rendered:
After a long wait, Nikki from the 2026 horror hit Obsession has arrived in Fortnite, landing in the Item Shop on October 21 at 8 PM ET (5 PM PT). This comes a few months after the game’s official X handle first teased a collab with the film, way back in July. Recently, the One Wish Willow, an integral part of the movie’s plot, was added as a Fortnite Override sprite, which was also the first Obsession-themed content to drop.

The Nikki skin is available in the Item Shop for 1,500 V-Bucks, and it can also be purchased as part of the Obsession Bundle for 2,000 V-Bucks. All these Obsession-inspired cosmetic items will be up for grabs for a limited time, until October 31 at 8 PM ET (5 PM PT).

For those looking to add to their collection of movie IP characters in Fortnite, Obsession’s Nikki may be a tempting pick. In that case, you can do as shown in the images below to grab it from the in-game store.

How to get the Obsession Nikki skin in Fortnite

  1. In Fortnite, navigate to the Shop tab.
  2. Then, scroll down to the Obsession section and select the desired skin.
  3. Finally, press and hold the Purchase button to confirm your pick.

All Obsession cosmetics in Fortnite

1. Nikki outfit

  • Price: 1,500 V-Bucks
  • Also available in: Obsession Bundle

2. Nikki’s Broken Bottle pickaxe

  • Price: 500 V-Bucks
  • Also available in: Obsession Bundle

3. One Wish Willow back bling

  • Price: 300 V-Bucks
  • Also available in: Obsession Bundle

4. No No No… emote

  • Price: 400 V-Bucks
  • Also available in: Obsession Bundle

Fortnite and its movie collaborations in 2026

So far this year, players have seen Fortnite roll out the red carpet for a plethora of popular movie collabs, especially with Hollywood flicks. While Obsession is the latest entry, major 2026 releases such as Spider-Man: Brand New Day, The Odyssey, and Street Fighter have been some other prominent inclusions. Not to mention, certain older films, ranging from A Nightmare on Elm Street to Rambo, have also made an appearance.

Given such a prolific cadence, it’s hard not to think there are more such Fortnite collabs to come in the final months. With Avengers: Doomsday yet to hit theaters on December 18, it seems almost certain that the game would partner with the Marvel Cinematic Universe, one of its biggest longtime collaborators, to bring another string of crossover content. More on that should become clear through the routine leaks next month.

With more entertainment franchises available for potential crossovers, players will likely continue watching for future collaborations. However, any upcoming movie tie-ins should be treated as speculation until Fortnite or the relevant rights holders confirm them.

FAQs

Is Bear from Obsession in Fortnite?

No, Bear hasn’t been released in the Item Shop. Nikki is the only Obsession character available for purchase in the game.

Is the Nikki skin in the Battle Pass?

No, the Nikki skin isn’t part of the Battle Pass. It’s an Item Shop exclusive that can only be bought with V-Bucks, either on its own or as part of the Obsession Bundle.

What does the Splatter style do?

The Splatter style toggle (part of the Nikki skin) adds dark stains on Nikki’s face and torso, a reference to her iconic bloody look in Obsession.

Can I refund the bundle?

Yes, you can cancel the purchase within 24 hours, as long as you haven’t equipped the items in a match. After that, you can still use one of your Return Tickets within 30 days of buying it.

Will Nikki come back?

While it can’t be said for sure if Nikki will return to Fortnite in the future, there have been many instances where the game has recycled past crossover content in the Item Shop. So, an eventual comeback is more likely to happen than not.

title.rendered: Destroy a Vault codes (October 2026)

content.rendered:
Update: Verified the latest Destroy a Vault Codes on October 27, 2026

It’s fair to say that Destroy a Vault is easily one of the most entertaining Roblox games you can try out right now. Your main goal is to blast open valuable vaults with an army of tanks, grab as much gold as possible, and keep moving on to bigger vaults. As fun as that sounds, becoming a successful vault buster in this game isn’t as easy as it sounds, because you’ll need rare tanks and the right upgrades to get the job done.

You can obviously spend Robux to get your hands on these resources, but there’s a better way to get them without spending a dime. The developers regularly release codes that can reward you with free Gems, Cash, Admin Shards, and various other items. So, if you want to grab these freebies, here’s a list of the active Destroy a Vault codes you should redeem right away!

All working Destroy a Vault codes

  • MOREGEMS: 25,000 Gems (NEW)
  • FIRSTAA: One Lucky Roll (NEW)
  • BUGFIXES: 25,000 Gems (NEW)
  • 10KLIKES: $30,000
  • Halloween2025: 30 min Mastery Boost
  • 1M: 1h Mastery Boost
  • JACK: $50,000
  • BOSS: 25,000 Gems
  • 1MILLION: One Lucky Roll

As of now, these are the only active Destroy a Vault codes available. Make sure to redeem them as soon as possible, as codes can expire without warning, leaving you unable to claim their rewards.

Expired Destroy a Vault codes

BETA, DESTROY

How to redeem Destroy a Vault codes in Roblox

Knowing the active codes isn’t enough, gamers! You also need to know how to redeem them and claim your free rewards. Thankfully, the process only takes a few minutes. Here’s a step-by-step guide on how to redeem Destroy a Vault codes:

  1. Fire up Destroy a Vault on Roblox.
  2. Wait for the lobby to load and complete the short tutorial.
  3. Click the Settings (gear) icon in the top-right corner and scroll down to find the codes box.
  4. Paste a working code and hit Redeem to claim your reward.

Once you’ve redeemed the codes, the rewards should be added to your inventory automatically.

Why aren’t my Destroy a Vault codes working?

If your Destroy a Vault codes aren’t working, double-check that you’ve entered them exactly as listed above. Keep in mind that these codes are case-sensitive, so make sure there are no extra spaces before or after them.

You can simply copy and paste the codes directly from our list. Some codes, like BUGFIX2, only work after you finish the tutorial. If a code still doesn’t work, it might’ve expired, or you may have already redeemed its rewards.

How to get more Destroy a Vault codes

The developers don’t follow a fixed schedule for releasing new Destroy a Vault codes. Most codes are released to celebrate major game updates, seasonal events, or community milestones.

title.rendered: Minecraft Brittle Ice: How to find, collect, and farm it

content.rendered:
One of the new additions in Minecraft 26.4 Snapshot 4 (Java Edition) is Brittle Ice. So, what is it? Well, it’s a brand-new block that generates naturally in Ice Caves and starts cracking when a player or most mobs step on it (the Frostbite is one mob that can walk on it safely). Eventually, the block breaks, making it useful for creating parkour maps, traps, and survival challenges.

Since Brittle Ice only generates naturally as part of Ice Cave crevasses, you might think exploring these areas is the only way to get it. However, that’s not the case. You can also create Brittle Ice using Blue Ice and water. So, here’s a complete guide on how to find, collect, and farm Brittle Ice in Minecraft.

All materials needed to get Brittle Ice in Minecraft

Before you begin the process of obtaining Brittle Ice, there are a few items you’ll need to gather first:

I’d recommend getting a pickaxe with Silk Touch first. You’ll need this enchantment to collect Brittle Ice as a block, and it also helps you gather Blue Ice without destroying it.

How you can obtain brittle ice in Minecraft

The easiest way to obtain Brittle Ice in Minecraft is to head to the Ice Caves. However, not only can this get tiring, but it’s also quite dangerous, as you will run into various mobs before you manage to collect the resource. The better option is to build a Brittle Ice farm, as it allows you to generate and collect it right at your base without having to travel anywhere.

Once you’ve collected all the resources mentioned above, here’s what you’ll need to do:

  1. Dig a trench that’s five blocks long and one block deep.
  2. Place a Blue Ice block at one end of the trench.
  3. Head to the other end and empty your Water Bucket.
  4. The water will flow toward the Blue Ice block, and the water touching it will automatically turn into Brittle Ice.

After the Brittle Ice has been generated, use a Silk Touch pickaxe to mine and collect it. As long as you have a Blue Ice block at the end of the trench and you keep placing water at the other end, you can continue generating new Brittle Ice blocks.

Also Read: How to change gamemode in Minecraft

Wrapping up

Brittle Ice is a new block in Minecraft that you can find naturally in Ice Caves or create using Blue Ice and water. While exploring caves is a good way to discover it, building a small farm makes collecting more blocks much easier.

Beyond its decorative appeal, Brittle Ice can be useful for parkour maps, traps, and survival challenges because it cracks and breaks underfoot. Just remember to use a Silk Touch pickaxe when collecting it, and check that you’re playing a version that supports the feature, which right now means the Java Edition 26.4 snapshots.

FAQs

Can you walk on Brittle Ice in Minecraft?

You can walk on Brittle Ice in Minecraft, but it will start to crack under your feet and break if you stay on it for too long.

What is Brittle Ice used for in Minecraft?

Brittle Ice can be used for decoration, parkour maps, and survival challenges. As the block breaks when a player or mob steps on it, it can also be used to create traps.

Where does Brittle Ice spawn in Minecraft?

Brittle Ice blocks can be found naturally in Ice Caves in Minecraft, where they generate as part of crevasses. You can explore these areas to find the block.

title.rendered: How to use Wrist Flick on Apple Watch to dismiss notifications

content.rendered:
Notifications are useful, but they can also become a constant distraction—especially when you’re working out, carrying groceries, or in the middle of something. That’s where Wrist Flick comes in. Introduced in watchOS 26, this handy gesture lets you dismiss notifications, silence incoming calls, and stop timers with a quick wrist movement, without touching the display.

In watchOS 27, Wrist Flick remains a convenient way to control your Apple Watch hands-free. Here’s how to use the gesture in everyday life.

What is Wrist Flick on Apple Watch?

Wrist Flick is a one-handed gesture that lets you interact with your Apple Watch without tapping or swiping the screen. It uses the watch’s motion sensors and gesture recognition to detect a quick wrist turn. And when the watch recognizes the gesture, it dismisses the current notification or alert and returns you to the watch face.

Think of it as brushing away a distraction. It’s particularly useful when your other hand is occupied or when touching the screen isn’t convenient.

Wrist Flick debuted in watchOS 26, and Apple continues to support it in watchOS 27. It works alongside other hands-free features, including Double Tap and the newer single-tap gesture introduced in watchOS 27.

What can you do with Wrist Flick?

Once enabled, Wrist Flick lets you handle several common interruptions without touching your Apple Watch.

  • Dismiss notifications: Clear incoming messages, reminders, weather alerts, and other notifications from the screen.
  • Mute incoming calls: Silence an incoming call without reaching for the display.
  • Stop timers and silence alarms: Quickly dismiss timer and alarm alerts.
  • Return to the watch face: Clear the current screen and get back to your watch face.
  • Dismiss other alerts: Handle supported system alerts with the same quick wrist movement.

Wrist Flick is designed to make interacting with your watch easier, not to replace every on-screen control. Dismissing a notification doesn’t delete the underlying message or other content from its app. You can still open the relevant app to review information later.

Likewise, silencing an incoming call doesn’t mean you’ve answered it. You can still decide whether to answer or decline the call.

Compatible Apple Watch Models

Wrist Flick is supported on Apple Watch models with the required hardware and software.

Compatible models include:

  • Apple Watch Series 9
  • Apple Watch Series 10
  • Apple Watch Series 11
  • Apple Watch Series 12
  • Apple Watch Ultra 2
  • Apple Watch Ultra 3
  • Apple Watch Ultra 4
  • Apple Watch SE 3

Wrist Flick requires a compatible watch running watchOS 26 or later. For the latest models, including the Series 12 and Ultra 4, watchOS 27 is the relevant software version.

Older models, such as Apple Watch Series 8 and the original Apple Watch Ultra, aren’t supported for Wrist Flick. Although these watches offer other ways to silence alerts, they don’t support this particular gesture.

How to use Wrist Flick on Apple Watch

Wrist Flick is enabled by default on compatible Apple Watch models. If it isn’t working as expected, check its setting before trying the gesture again.

  1. Open the Settings app on your Apple Watch.
  2. Go to Gestures.
  3. Toggle Wrist Flick on or off.

Perform the Wrist Flick gesture

  1. Wait for a notification, incoming call, timer, or other supported alert.
  2. Quickly turn your wrist away from you.
  3. Bring your wrist back toward you in one smooth movement.
  4. Wait for the watch to recognize the gesture and dismiss the alert.

You don’t need to make an exaggerated movement. A quick, deliberate wrist turn is usually enough. If the gesture doesn’t register, try again with a slightly more distinct movement and make sure the watch is fitted securely on your wrist.

With a little practice, Wrist Flick can become second nature, allowing you to manage interruptions without breaking your stride.

Here’s a quick video on how to use it:

Wrist Flick vs. Double Tap and the New Tap Gesture

Apple offers several gestures to make Apple Watch easier to use with one hand. Although Wrist Flick, Double Tap, and the new single-tap gesture all reduce the need to touch the screen, they serve different purposes.

  • Wrist Flick is primarily for dismissing notifications, silencing incoming calls, stopping timers, and returning to the watch face.
  • Double Tap involves tapping your index finger and thumb together twice. It supports actions such as answering calls, replying to messages, scrolling through the Smart Stack, and interacting with compatible apps.
  • The new Tap gesture in watchOS 27 involves bringing your index finger and thumb together once. It lets you select a highlighted Smart Stack widget and quickly access relevant information when your other hand is occupied.

These gestures complement one another.

Another useful option is Cover to Mute. Simply rest your palm over the watch display for at least three seconds to silence an alert. Unlike Wrist Flick, this gesture is primarily designed to mute an alert temporarily.

More useful features in watchOS 27

Wrist Flick is just one part of the Apple Watch experience. watchOS 27 also introduces refinements and features designed to make everyday interactions more convenient.

  • New Siri AI: A more capable Siri experience, with advanced Apple Intelligence integration for on-screen awareness, personal context, and cross-app actions.
  • A dedicated Siri app: Revisit conversations with Siri in one place.
  • A new Tap gesture: Select a highlighted Smart Stack widget with a single finger-and-thumb tap.
  • Smarter Smart Stack suggestions: Get more relevant widgets and contextual suggestions based on your routines and activities.
  • A dynamic app grid: Find and open apps through an updated app-launching experience.
  • Improved everyday interactions: Refinements across watchOS make it easier to access useful information and interact with your watch.

If you’re upgrading from watchOS 26, Wrist Flick itself won’t feel entirely new. The main benefit is that you can keep using this familiar gesture while taking advantage of other watchOS 27 improvements.

A small gesture that makes a big difference

Wrist Flick isn’t the flashiest Apple Watch feature, but it’s a practical example of how small software improvements can make a wearable easier to use. Instead of interrupting what you’re doing to tap away a notification or silence a call, you can handle it with a quick movement of your wrist.

On the Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4, Wrist Flick remains a simple, effective way to reduce distractions and interact with your watch hands-free. It’s easy to learn, enabled by default, and useful whenever your hands are busy.

If you haven’t tried it yet, give it a go. Once you get used to the movement, you’ll have one more convenient way to keep your attention where it belongs.

title.rendered: How to get the Slender Man skin in Fortnite: Price and bundle

content.rendered:
After several days of circulating rumors about its release date, Slender Man has finally rolled out in Fortnite. The faceless villain has joined an illustrious lineup of antagonists from third-party IPs featured in Fortnite this Halloween season. The skin, which is part of the wider Fortnite x Slender Man collab, was officially confirmed when it first appeared in the promotional art for Fortnitemares around late September, and it landed in the Item Shop on October 22 at 5 PM PT / 8 PM ET.

The Slender Man skin is available in the Item Shop for 1,500 V-Bucks. It is also included in the namesake bundle, which goes for 2,000 V-Bucks (down from 2,700 V-Bucks) in the game. These cosmetics are only available to buy for a limited time, until November 1, 5 PM PT or 8 PM ET, the same day on which a new Fortnite season will also kick off.

Players who placed high enough in the Slender Man Cup on October 20 already unlocked the outfit and back bling for free, so the Item Shop is now the only way to get them.

If you are interested in purchasing the Slender Man skin in Fortnite, make sure to follow the steps shown below.

Steps to get the Slender Man skin in Fortnite

  1. In Fortnite, go to the Shop tab.
  2. Next, scroll down to the Slender Man section and select the desired skin.
  3. Finally, press and hold the Purchase button to confirm your decision.

All Slender Man cosmetics in Fortnite

1. The Slender Man (Outfit)

  • Price: 1,500 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: The Slender Man Bundle

2. Slender Tendrils (Pickaxe)

  • Price: 800 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: The Slender Man Bundle

3. Tentacles of the Slender Man (Back Bling)

  • Price: 400 V-Bucks
  • Also included in: The Slender Man Bundle

Popular horror characters in Fortnitemares 2026

This year’s rendition of Fortnitemares has been nothing short of exciting for players. From classic monsters to legendary Hollywood villains, we have seen a wide spectrum of bad guys emerge in the Item Shop throughout October. This list has included characters such as Frankenstein’s Monster, The Mummy, Freddy Krueger, Jason Voorhees, and the like.

Apart from Slender Man, Nikki from Obsession is another character that Fortnite has added as a skin, and she delivers a strong level of creepiness. Given that antagonists from yesteryear and the modern day are both part of this Halloween-themed event, it’s fair to say players have had a good range of choices for the Fortnitemares experience.

title.rendered: Aetheria map in Fortnite: What it is, how to play it, beginner tips

content.rendered:
Ever since Fortnite evolved from a game into a Roblox-like platform, a flurry of Fortnite Creative and UEFN maps by third parties has emerged, including Aetheria, one of the more popular maps from the lot. Developed by CooliSushi, Aetheria is an open-world RPG that first rolled out in November 2025 (island code 1314-6986-8879) and has attracted tens of thousands of players to date.

At the time of writing, Aetheria has been experiencing a daily concurrent player peak of around 2,502, per Fortnite.gg. Given its all-time peak of 6,559 players, it may not seem all that exciting on the surface. However, relative to other UEFN maps, it is reasonably notable in how well it holds onto its audience. It also currently sits near the top of Fortnite’s Adventure & RPG genre charts.

Below, you can learn more about Aetheria, its gameplay, the game objectives, and more. Apart from that, you can also check out its code and how you can play it within Fortnite.

What is Aetheria in Fortnite?

Aetheria is a fantasy RPG where you can go on quests, defeat untamed beasts, farm otherworldly creatures, and hunt for hidden chests, among other things. The game is playable as a single-player experience or with up to a total of six players.

From bustling markets crawling with human NPCs to monster-infested wilderness, and from lush green forests to snow-capped peaks, there’s a considerable amount of depth in Aetheria’s open world, which you can explore either on foot or by using fast travel points. As you talk to more NPCs and complete more quests, you unlock new parts of the map.

Like many fantasy RPGs, combat is an integral aspect of Aetheria’s gameplay. However, unlike most Fortnite maps, the arsenal at your disposal features a mix of melee weapons, such as a rapier, and ranged weapons, such as a musket.

Using these tools, you can go up against various enemies, ranging from grotesque goblins to giant crabs. As you progress through the game, you can collect XP and use it to upgrade weapons for taking on more challenging foes.

How to play Aetheria in Fortnite?

  1. In Fortnite, scroll down to the Discover section.
  2. Select the search bar near the top-right part of the screen.
  3. Type in the map code 1314-6986-8879.
  4. From the results, select Aetheria by CooliSushi.
  5. Hit Select to switch to this map.
  6. Finally, hit Play to launch Aetheria.

Tips to get started in the Aetheria map in Fortnite

One of the first things you should focus on in Aetheria is completing quests offered by the game’s characters. Explore the world, look for quest markers, and use the in-game guidance to find your next objective. You should also check your quest log regularly to track your progress and see what you need to do next.

Another useful tip is to open chests whenever you come across them. They can provide valuable rewards and help you progress. Keep an eye out for hidden chests while exploring, as they may offer useful items that support your adventure.

Better equipment can also make combat much easier. Take a break from quests and exploration now and then to review your gear and available upgrades. Improving your weapons and abilities before taking on tougher enemies or bosses can help you handle challenging encounters.

Finally, don’t rush through the world. Explore different areas, talk to NPCs, and experiment with the game’s combat mechanics. Taking the time to understand how quests, upgrades, and exploration work can make your early hours in Aetheria more enjoyable.

Rounding up

Fortnite maps built by third-party developers play an undeniable role in diversifying the experience on the platform, letting players jump into different adventures without ever leaving Epic’s hit multiplayer title. Aetheria is one such map that’s worth mentioning in this regard, and it scratches the itch for Fortnite players who also happen to be RPG enthusiasts.

Developed by CooliSushi, the map combines quests, creature battles, exploration, and character progression in one experience. Whether you’re playing solo or teaming up with friends, Aetheria offers an alternative to Fortnite’s traditional battle royale gameplay. Use the island code 1314-6986-8879 to jump in and start exploring.

title.rendered: Apple adds an AI assistant to Pages, Keynote, and Numbers that understands your work

content.rendered:
Apple is bringing a new AI assistant to Pages, Keynote, and Numbers that can help you write documents, create presentations, and analyze spreadsheets using natural language. Called Intelligent Assistant, the feature understands the content you’re working on and can make changes directly within each app.

The new assistant is rolling out in beta for Apple Creator Studio subscribers, according to Apple’s latest App Store release notes for Pages, Keynote, and Numbers.

What’s new in Pages, Keynote and Numbers

In Pages, you can ask the assistant to draft entire sections, rewrite existing text, adjust the tone, or reorganize your document. It can also generate images and shapes based on text instructions. Since the assistant understands the document’s contents, you can ask it to make changes using the context of what you’ve already written.

Keynote gets similar capabilities focused on presentations. The assistant can generate slides, create presenter notes, add images and shapes, and help refine existing slides. You can also ask it to add animations or improve a presentation without having to manually work through each element.

Numbers brings AI assistance to spreadsheets, including the ability to create complex formulas, generate tables, suggest charts, and find insights in existing data. For example, you can describe what you want to calculate in plain English and have the assistant help build the formula.

Across all three apps, Intelligent Assistant can search for up-to-date information and incorporate it into your document, presentation, or spreadsheet. It can also explain advanced features and guide users through unfamiliar tasks.

The update builds on AI features Apple has already introduced through Creator Studio, including image generation, automatic slide creation in Keynote, and Magic Fill in Numbers. Intelligent Assistant brings these capabilities into a more conversational interface that understands the project you’re editing.

There are some restrictions. Intelligent Assistant is currently available only in US English and requires an Apple Intelligence-compatible device running iOS 27 or iPadOS 27 or later. Apple’s Mac App Store listings have yet to receive the corresponding update.

The features also require an Apple Creator Studio subscription, which costs $12.99 per month or $129 per year in the US. Pages, Keynote, and Numbers remain free for regular document creation and editing.

Separately, Keynote is introducing a new open Interchange Format (.keyx) in beta. Available to all users, the format allows presentations to be imported and exported in a way that Apple says will make their contents easier to work with in other applications.

excerpt.rendered: Apple’s Intelligent Assistant can write in Pages, build slides in Keynote, and help with formulas in Numbers. It is in beta for Creator Studio subscribers in US English.

title.rendered: YouTube is moving Subscriptions out of the bottom bar on Android and iOS after nine years

content.rendered:
Since 2017, the videos from channels you follow have been one tap away at the bottom of YouTube’s mobile app. That’s about to change. YouTube is removing the Subscriptions tab from the bottom bar on Android and iOS. The tab is being renamed "Subs" and moved to a new row of feeds at the top of the Home tab.

Subscriptions used to be the fourth item in the bottom bar. Without it, the bar has four items: Home, Shorts, Create, and You. In the new layout, Subs is second in Home’s top bar, right after Home, with a red underline when you select it. The feed itself still shows uploads from the channels you follow. Getting to it now takes two steps: open Home, then reach up to the top of the screen.

That’s a step backward. On a tall phone, the top of the screen is the hardest spot to reach with one hand. The bottom bar is where an app puts the places you go most, and for a lot of people, that’s Subscriptions. It was also the one feed that showed only what you chose to follow. Now it sits in a row with feeds YouTube picks for you.

YouTube has been working toward this for months. In May, it tested a version that moved Subscriptions to a menu at the top of the screen and called it an experiment. That test is now the default design.

Subs now shares the top bar with Live, Music, and feeds you describe

After Subs, the top bar has feeds for Live and Music. A Movies & TV feed shows up only if you pay for something like Primetime Channels. The redesign also gets rid of the app’s slide-out navigation menu.

Custom feeds are launching at the same time. Tap the "+" at the top of Home and describe what you want to watch: a topic, a type of video, or a mood. YouTube then builds a feed that keeps filling with new videos. Each custom feed gets its own tab after Home and Subs. Free users can keep three at a time, and Premium members can keep eight. Your feeds sync between mobile and desktop, only you can see them, and they expire after 30 days if you don’t use them. Videos you watch in a custom feed count toward your regular watch history, so they can change what shows up on your main Home feed too.

Custom feeds are rolling out first in the US. You need to be signed in, be 13 or older, use YouTube in English, and have watch and search history turned on. YouTube says more countries will follow, and it calls these changes the start of "a series of updates to shape a more seamless Home experience." It hasn’t said when the new bottom bar will reach everyone.

title.rendered: Apple will label apps optimized for iPhone Duo with a new App Store badge

content.rendered:
Apple’s iPhone Duo introduces a new form factor to the iPhones, and many existing apps haven’t been optimized for its larger screen. Some older apps will appear with wide black bars on either side, leaving much of the 7.6-inch inner display unused. To help users find apps that properly support the foldable, Apple is introducing a “Made for iPhone Duo” badge on App Store listings as the phone launches on October 23.

The badge will appear on individual app pages, making it easier to identify apps designed to take advantage of the Duo’s larger display and folding design. Apple will also introduce dedicated App Store collections featuring optimized apps and games.

Only apps built with the iOS 27.1 SDK count as optimized

Apple’s developer documentation also states how an app appears on the Duo depends partly on the iOS SDK used to build it. Apps built with iOS 26 or earlier remain in a smaller window, while those built with iOS 27 fill most of the inner screen but leave some space unused near the status bar.

Apps built with the iOS 27.1 SDK or later can use the entire display, with toolbars and navigation controls arranged vertically along the right edge. Developers can get the new badge displayed on their App Store listings by submitting iPhone Duo screenshots through App Store Connect.

Several popular apps have already been updated to take advantage of the new design. Netflix lets users browse short clips on the outer screen and continue watching on the larger inner display. Prime Video can play a movie on the upper half of the partially folded screen while showing cast information and other details below.

Zoom can display meeting participants alongside shared content, while Lyft shows a larger route map next to available ride options. Microsoft is also preparing updated versions of Word and Outlook that place documents, formatting tools, and emails side by side, with those updates expected in the coming weeks. Here are some examples Apple showcased on their site.

Apple says more apps will receive iPhone Duo optimizations throughout the year. With many developers still adapting their apps, the new badge should make it easier for users to find those that make proper use of the foldable screen.

excerpt.rendered: Apple will flag App Store listings for apps optimized for iPhone Duo, which are built with the iOS 27.1 SDK. The first Duo collections go live Friday, October 23.
